words.englishDefinition: to create or produce something
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料や考えを使って何かを作り出すこと。
words.example: Let's make a birthday card for our teacher.

words.englishDefinition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
words.example: You need somebody like me to take care of your kids.

words.englishDefinition: to notice with your eyes; to meet someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 目で見ることや、人に会うこと。文脈で意味が変わる。
words.example: I can see the mountains from my window.

words.englishDefinition: Exert oneself by doing mental or physical work for a purpose or out of necessity
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的のためにまたは必要に迫られて、精神的、物理的な行動をすることによって尽力する。
words.example: I must work hard to make up for lost time.

words.englishDefinition: Perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意して知覚する。その人の視線を向ける。
words.example: I will look after your child this evening.

words.englishDefinition: to contact someone by telephone; to ask someone to come
words.japaneseExplanation: 電話をかけたり、誰かを呼んだりすること。
words.example: I'll call you when I get to the station.

words.englishDefinition: Persist for a specified period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の期間やり通す。
words.example: I wonder how long this cold weather will last.

words.englishDefinition: between noon and midnight
words.japaneseExplanation: 午後を表す時刻の表記。午後三時は three p.m.。
words.example: The library closes at six p.m. on Fridays.

words.englishDefinition: The facility where wild animals are housed for exhibition
words.japaneseExplanation: 野生動物が展示のために飼われている設備。
words.example: How many animals do you think are in this zoo?

words.englishDefinition: A living organism characterized by voluntary movement
words.japaneseExplanation: 自発的な運動に特徴付けられる、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: Can you think of an animal that's black and white?

words.englishDefinition: A day or period of time set aside for feasting and celebration
words.japaneseExplanation: 祝宴と祝賀のためにとっておいた日または時間。
words.example: I hope that people will come to our festival.

words.englishDefinition: a very large animal with a long trunk
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い鼻と大きな体を持つ動物のゾウ。
words.example: The elephant picked up some food with its trunk.

words.englishDefinition: The specified day of the month
words.japaneseExplanation: 月の特定の日。
words.example: What is the date today?

words.englishDefinition: A branch of knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識の分野。
words.example: What more is there to say on this subject?

words.englishDefinition: A mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品またはサービスの小売販売のための商業の施設。
words.example: I bought eggs at the store on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: between midnight and noon
words.japaneseExplanation: 午前を表す時刻の表記。午前九時は nine a.m.。
words.example: My first class starts at nine a.m. tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: An artifact designed to be played with
words.japaneseExplanation: 遊ぶために考案された人工品。
words.example: You should ask for help if a toy is broken.

words.englishDefinition: a story shown in moving pictures
words.japaneseExplanation: 映像で物語などを見せる映画。
words.example: Would you like to watch a movie tonight?

words.englishDefinition: A time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、金曜日の夜から日曜日までの期間。日曜日、あるいは一度のみの日曜日を含む連続した日付期間のいずれかであると緩く定義された。
words.example: I want to spend time with my children this weekend.

words.englishDefinition: An occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
words.japaneseExplanation: 2人以上の競争者から勝者が選ばれる機会。
words.example: I thought that you were going to win the contest.

words.englishDefinition: The most common medium of exchange; functions as legal tender
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も普通に使われている交換手段。法定貨幣として機能している。
words.example: What makes us free is the money, not the law.

words.englishDefinition: a place where you pay to eat a meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 代金を払って食事をする店。
words.example: Let's try the new restaurant near the station.

words.englishDefinition: Not the same one or ones already mentioned or implied
words.japaneseExplanation: 既に述べた、または示したのと同じものではない。
words.example: I still haven't eaten the chocolate that you gave me the other day.

words.englishDefinition: Dearly loved
words.japaneseExplanation: 心から愛されている。
words.example: My mother has sold everything that is dear to her.

words.englishDefinition: in a good or skillful way
words.japaneseExplanation: 動作が上手にできることを表す副詞。
words.example: My sister plays the piano very well.

words.englishDefinition: Able to act at will; not hampered; not under compulsion or restraint
words.japaneseExplanation: 意のままに行動することができる。妨げられない。
words.example: Please feel free to stay as long as you like.

words.englishDefinition: (superlative of 'good') having the most positive qualities
words.japaneseExplanation: もっとも肯定的な特質がある。
words.example: We tried our best to have a good time.

words.englishDefinition: Widely known and esteemed
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く知られ、尊重される。
words.example: I wonder what it would be like to be famous.

words.englishDefinition: Unique or specific to a person or thing or category
words.japaneseExplanation: 人、物またはカテゴリーに特有または限られた。
words.example: Do you have anyone special in mind for the job?

words.englishDefinition: Limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 数、量、大きさまたは範囲が制限された、あるいは平均以下の。
words.example: I think that car is a little too small for you.

words.englishDefinition: Gain knowledge or skills
words.japaneseExplanation: 知識または能力を獲得する。
words.example: I wish I could learn every language in the world.

words.englishDefinition: Express in words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で表現する。
words.example: Can you please tell me what time the train leaves?

words.englishDefinition: Have need of
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要性を有する。
words.example: You will need much more money than you do now.

words.englishDefinition: Derive or receive pleasure from; get enjoyment from; take pleasure in
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜びを引き出す、または受ける。悦楽を得る。
words.example: I never thought I would enjoy living in the country.

words.englishDefinition: Increase in size by natural process
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然なプロセスによるサイズの増加。
words.example: I don't want our child to grow up here.

words.englishDefinition: Be the cause or source of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの原因または源となる。
words.example: Could you please give me a piece of information?

words.englishDefinition: Come or bring to a finish or an end
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕上げるあるうは終わりにくるあるいはそれをもたらす。
words.example: I will finish it by the time he comes back.

words.englishDefinition: A journey to a place and back, usually for a short time.
words.japaneseExplanation: ある場所へ行って戻る旅行や外出のこと。
words.example: We have just returned from a trip around the world.

words.englishDefinition: A message received and understood
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け取られて、理解されるメッセージ。
words.example: Do you really want this information to be made public?

words.englishDefinition: A category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通の特徴や質で区別されるものの範疇。
words.example: I think there has been some kind of mistake.

words.englishDefinition: A reference book containing an alphabetical list of words with information about them
words.japaneseExplanation: 単語に関する情報が載っている単語のアルファベット順のリストを含む参考図書。
words.example: I can't understand this word. Do you have a dictionary?

words.englishDefinition: Any solid substance (as opposed to liquid) that is used as a source of nourishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 栄養物として用いられる固形物質（液体に対するものとして）。
words.example: I still have to buy some food for the party.

words.englishDefinition: A licensed medical practitioner
words.japaneseExplanation: 認可された医者。
words.example: I feel very bad, I must see a doctor.

words.englishDefinition: The principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
words.japaneseExplanation: 金銭を稼ぐために行う生活の中での主要な活動。
words.example: Do you think he did the job on his own?

words.englishDefinition: Young domestic cat
words.japaneseExplanation: イエネコの子。
words.example: I have a kitten in the next room.

words.englishDefinition: Establishment where a seat of higher learning is housed, including administrative and living quarters as well as facilities for research and teaching
words.japaneseExplanation: 研究と教育のための施設だけでなく管理局、住居区を含む高等教育の中枢が収容されている施設。
words.example: I think Tom is a student at the university where I used to teach.

words.englishDefinition: Something determined in relation to something that includes it
words.japaneseExplanation: ある物を含む物に関連して決定される物。
words.example: I just don't want to be a part of it.

words.englishDefinition: A point located with respect to surface features of some region
words.japaneseExplanation: ある地域の表面の特徴に関して見つけられたポイント。
words.example: I know a place where we can get some money.

words.englishDefinition: Activities that are enjoyable or amusing
words.japaneseExplanation: 楽しい、おもしろい活動。
words.example: I do this for the fun of it.

words.englishDefinition: a mother or father
words.japaneseExplanation: 母親または父親を表す。parents なら両親などの複数。
words.example: Each child must come with a parent.

words.englishDefinition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
words.example: I can't remember the last time I took a vacation.

words.englishDefinition: A person who performs voluntary work
words.japaneseExplanation: ボランティア労働に従事する人。
words.example: I have a friend who works as a volunteer.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かをした、あるいはしなかったことについて後悔、悲しみ、あるいは喪失感を感じること、あるいは表すさま。
words.example: We feel sorry about what happened between you.

words.englishDefinition: (comparative of 'good') superior to another (of the same class or set or kind) in excellence or quality or desirability or suitability; more highly skilled than another
words.japaneseExplanation: 素晴らしさ、品質、好ましさあるいは適合性のもう一つ（同じ部類、組、種類の）より優れている。別の人よりさらに高い技術を示す。
words.example: Do you think you're a better cook than I am?

words.englishDefinition: Regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に一般大衆によってとても好かれ、受け入れられ、愛されている。
words.example: I am a popular girl at school.

words.englishDefinition: Free from error; especially conforming to fact or truth
words.japaneseExplanation: エラーがない。特に事実や真実に従う。
words.example: You took the words right out of my mouth.

words.englishDefinition: liked more than others
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかのものより特に好きなこと。
words.example: What is your favorite food to cook at home?

words.englishDefinition: Affected by an impairment of normal physical or mental function
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の身体的であるか精神的な機能の減退に影響を受ける。
words.example: I have never been sick since I was a child.

words.englishDefinition: Actively or fully engaged or occupied
words.japaneseExplanation: 活発に、完全に、占められた、独占された。
words.example: I was too busy to eat lunch.

words.englishDefinition: after the expected or usual time
words.japaneseExplanation: 予定や普段の時刻より遅いこと。
words.example: Sorry I'm late. I missed the bus.

words.englishDefinition: Come upon, as if by accident; meet with
words.japaneseExplanation: まるで偶然かのように、出会う。会う。
words.example: I don't want to find you here when I come back.

words.englishDefinition: Change location; move, travel, or proceed, also metaphorically
words.japaneseExplanation: 場所を変える。また比喩的にも移動する、旅をするまたは前進する。
words.example: We travel not to move, but to change our mind.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be directed or transmitted to another place
words.japaneseExplanation: 案内される、または別の場所に送信される。
words.example: Please send me a letter as soon as you arrive.

words.englishDefinition: Take something or somebody with oneself somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 自らで、何かまたは誰かをどこかへ連れて行く。
words.example: Please bring me a chair from the next room.

words.englishDefinition: Make an effort or attempt
words.japaneseExplanation: 努力する、または試みる。
words.example: I told Tom he should try to do it by himself.

words.englishDefinition: Reach, make, or come to a decision about something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かについての決定に達する、実行する、に至る。
words.example: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

words.englishDefinition: Expect and wish
words.japaneseExplanation: 予期し期待する。
words.example: I hope you will come up with a better plan.

words.englishDefinition: Instrumentalists not including string players
words.japaneseExplanation: 弦楽器奏者を含まない器楽家達。
words.example: I liked that band better before they became popular.

words.englishDefinition: Intelligent somewhat arboreal ape of equatorial African forests
words.japaneseExplanation: 赤道付近のアフリカの森林の知的な多少樹上棲息に適する類人猿。
words.example: Tom had never seen a chimpanzee before.

words.englishDefinition: A depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
words.japaneseExplanation: 本と研究のために、本と他の資料を保存するために建設される保管所。
words.example: I like to go to the library and read books.

words.englishDefinition: A series of steps to be carried out or goals to be accomplished
words.japaneseExplanation: 実行するための一連の段階あるいは達成するべきゴール。
words.example: I didn't just make the plan, I carried it out.

words.englishDefinition: a message sent electronically over the internet
words.japaneseExplanation: インターネットを使って送る電子メール。email とも書く。
words.example: Please send me an e-mail with the meeting details.

words.englishDefinition: A period of time equal to 1/24th of a day
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間の周期、1日の1/24と等しい。
words.example: How many more hours do you think this will take?

words.englishDefinition: Systematic training by multiple repetitions
words.japaneseExplanation: 何度も繰り返すことによる体系的な訓練。
words.example: We make it a practice to take a walk every morning.

words.englishDefinition: A male human offspring
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の男の子。
words.example: My son is not at home, he is at school.

words.englishDefinition: A politically organized body of people under a single government
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の政府の下に政治的に組織された人々の集まり。
words.example: I had a dream I went back to my country.

words.englishDefinition: A formally arranged gathering
words.japaneseExplanation: 公式に準備された集まり。
words.example: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: A daily or weekly publication on folded sheets; contains news and articles and advertisements
words.japaneseExplanation: 折り畳まれた紙に書かれた日刊または週刊の出版物。ニュース、記事、広告を含む。
words.example: I think he doesn't want you to read the newspaper.

words.englishDefinition: A person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
words.japaneseExplanation: 一分野以上の科学の高度な知識を持つ人。
words.example: You know, I'm something of a scientist myself.

words.englishDefinition: A spot where something halts or pauses
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが停止あるいは立ち止まる場所。
words.example: I missed my stop. How long does it take to reach the next stop?

words.englishDefinition: A particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
words.japaneseExplanation: 境界が不確かな特定の地理的地域（通常いくつかの特別な目的にかなうか、その住民、文化または地理学によって特徴付けられる）。
words.example: I think I could use some help in this area.

words.englishDefinition: The sister of your father or mother; the wife of your uncle
words.japaneseExplanation: 父や母の姉妹。おじの妻。
words.example: My aunt was like a real mother to me.

words.englishDefinition: the largest part or number
words.japaneseExplanation: 全体の大部分、または最も多い数を表す。
words.example: Most of my friends walk to school.

words.englishDefinition: Delighting the senses or exciting intellectual or emotional admiration
words.japaneseExplanation: 感覚を活気づけ、知的情緒的賞賛を喚起する。
words.example: What is more beautiful than the smile of a child?

words.englishDefinition: At or within a short distance in space or time or having elements near each other
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間にせよ時間にせよ短い距離か短い距離内にある、あるいは要素が互いに近くにある。
words.example: How close to each other were you standing?

words.englishDefinition: Unlike in nature or quality or form or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 本質、性質、形体または程度において同様でない。
words.example: I need to move to a different country.

words.englishDefinition: as much or as many as needed
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な量や程度を満たしていること。enough time、old enough の語順に注意。
words.example: We have enough time to finish the game.

words.englishDefinition: Exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
words.japaneseExplanation: 保証をもたらすのに十分な運動をする、あるいは世話を行うさま。
words.example: Could you please check the door to make sure that it's locked?

words.englishDefinition: prepared to do something
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要な準備ができていること。ready to の後ろは動詞の原形。
words.example: Are you ready to leave for school?

words.englishDefinition: Showing or causing joy and pleasure; especially made happy
words.japaneseExplanation: 喜びを示す、または引き起こす。特に幸せにされる。
words.example: I didn't think you'd be here, but I'm glad you are.

words.englishDefinition: Travel from place to place, as for the purpose of finding work, preaching, or acting as a judge
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事を見つける、説教をする、裁判官の働く目的であちこちを旅行する。
words.example: I need to work for a year in order to have enough money to travel.

words.englishDefinition: Invite someone to one's house
words.japaneseExplanation: 家に人を招待する。
words.example: I would like to invite you to dinner.

words.englishDefinition: Become part of; become a member of a group or organization
words.japaneseExplanation: 一部になる。グループか組織のメンバーになる。
words.example: I think I should join a study group.

words.englishDefinition: (botany) a living organism lacking the power of locomotion
words.japaneseExplanation: 移動力のない、生命を持つ有機体。
words.example: Can you water the plants in the living room, please?

words.englishDefinition: Make visible or noticeable
words.japaneseExplanation: 見えるか、または目立たせる。
words.example: Please show me that one in the window over there.

words.englishDefinition: to start to be something
words.japaneseExplanation: ある状態や立場になること。後ろに名詞や形容詞を置く。
words.example: I want to become a teacher in the future.

words.englishDefinition: Have or hold in one's hands or grip
words.japaneseExplanation: その人の手または掴むことで持つ、あるいは固定する。
words.example: Please hold for a moment while I check on that.

words.englishDefinition: An institution created to conduct business
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業を行うために創設された機関。
words.example: I wanted to start a company, but I never got started.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various small flat sweet cakes ('biscuit' is the British term)
words.japaneseExplanation: 小型で平らな甘い菓子。
words.example: Do you want a cookie or something?

words.englishDefinition: A person who operates a farm
words.japaneseExplanation: 農場を経営する人。
words.example: I should have become a farmer like my father wanted.

words.englishDefinition: A plot of ground where plants are cultivated
words.japaneseExplanation: 植物を耕す小区画地。
words.example: What did you plant in your garden this year?

words.englishDefinition: The content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
words.japaneseExplanation: 認知の内容。その人が考えている主要な事柄。
words.example: What do you think about this idea?

words.englishDefinition: A unit of instruction
words.japaneseExplanation: 指示部隊。
words.example: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

words.englishDefinition: (medicine) something that treats or prevents or alleviates the symptoms of disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気の症状を治療する、予防する、または緩和する物。
words.example: I don't feel well. Could you give me some medicine?

words.englishDefinition: One of the twelve divisions of the calendar year
words.japaneseExplanation: 暦年を12に分けた中の1つ。
words.example: I get paid at the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: Usually large pulpy deep-yellow round fruit of the squash family maturing in late summer or early autumn
words.japaneseExplanation: 晩夏または初秋に熟しているスカッシュ科の通常大きなどろっとした濃い黄色丸い果物。
words.example: How big a pumpkin do you want?

words.englishDefinition: Any location outside the Earth's atmosphere
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の大気圏外の場所。
words.example: We need to make good use of this space.

words.englishDefinition: a place where trains stop for passengers
words.japaneseExplanation: 列車に乗ったり降りたりする駅。
words.example: I'll meet you outside the station at nine.

words.englishDefinition: The atmospheric conditions that comprise the state of the atmosphere in terms of temperature and wind and clouds and precipitation
words.japaneseExplanation: 温度、風、雲、および降水量の観点から、大気状態を形成する大気条件。
words.example: I played outside with everybody because the weather was good today.

words.englishDefinition: A unit of language that native speakers can identify
words.japaneseExplanation: ネイティブスピーカーが同定できる言語の単位。
words.example: I took him on his word when he said he'd never seen her before.

words.englishDefinition: The work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かまたは何かに処遇を施したり、または注意を払うこと。
words.example: I don't care what happens to my old car.

words.englishDefinition: A beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot
words.japaneseExplanation: ココア粉とミルクと砂糖から作られる飲料。通常暖かくして飲む。
words.example: I made myself a cup of hot chocolate.

words.englishDefinition: Same in identity
words.japaneseExplanation: アイデンティティが同じである。
words.example: I thought that we were on the same side.

words.englishDefinition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
words.example: I realize this is a difficult time for you.

words.englishDefinition: well or in a satisfactory condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 体調や状態がよいこと。「大丈夫」の意味でも使う。
words.example: I had a headache, but I feel fine now.

words.englishDefinition: Of or pertaining to or characteristic of Italy or its people or culture or language
words.japaneseExplanation: イタリアまたはその国民またはその文化またはその言語の、それらに関する、あるいはそれらに特徴的なさま。
words.example: I want to learn how to cook Italian food.

words.englishDefinition: Taken unawares or suddenly and feeling wonder or astonishment
words.japaneseExplanation: 不意に、または突然、驚嘆、あるいは驚きを感じるさま。
words.example: I am surprised by a lot of the things he does.

words.englishDefinition: Filled with fear or apprehension
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐怖や不安でいっぱいである。
words.example: I don't think you should be afraid to ask questions.

words.englishDefinition: every person or thing considered separately
words.japaneseExplanation: 集団の一人一人、一つ一つを個別に表す。
words.example: Each student needs a pencil and a notebook.

words.englishDefinition: Creating or arousing excitement
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮を生み出すこと、または喚起するさま。
words.example: I had never seen such an exciting baseball game before.

words.englishDefinition: Water falling in drops from vapor condensed in the atmosphere
words.japaneseExplanation: 大気中で凝縮された水蒸気から成る滴という形での水の落下。
words.example: We have been waiting for the rain to fall.

words.englishDefinition: Be the winner in a contest or competition; be victorious
words.japaneseExplanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝者である。勝利している。
words.example: Our team is likely to win the game.

words.englishDefinition: Put into a certain place or abstract location
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の場所または抽象的な場所に置く。
words.example: We need to find a safe place to put this.

words.englishDefinition: Be dressed in
words.japaneseExplanation: 身に付けている。
words.example: What are you going to wear to the party tonight?

words.englishDefinition: Keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g., "keep clean"
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、位置または活動を維持する。例えば、。
words.example: My father often tells me to keep things clean.

words.englishDefinition: The particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
words.japaneseExplanation: ある原因によって生み出された特定の聴覚的効果。
words.example: I love the sound of rain on the roof.

words.englishDefinition: Express in speech
words.japaneseExplanation: スピーチで表す。
words.example: Do you know whether or not she can speak English?

words.englishDefinition: A plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
words.japaneseExplanation: 製造のための施設のある1つかそれ以上の建物で成る工場。
words.example: My father and my older brother work in this factory.

words.englishDefinition: Water frozen in the solid state
words.japaneseExplanation: 凍って固体となった水。
words.example: I don't like to drink water with ice.

words.englishDefinition: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
words.japaneseExplanation: 薄いパンの練り粉に香料入りトマトソース・チーズを混ぜたものを塗って焼いたイタリアのオープンパイ。
words.example: I thought that pizza was what you wanted to eat.

words.englishDefinition: Something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery
words.japaneseExplanation: コンテストまたは競争の勝利または優勢のために、または、宝くじに勝つと与えられる何か。
words.example: I did everything I could to win this prize.

words.englishDefinition: a spoken or written account of information
words.japaneseExplanation: 調べたことや起きたことをまとめた報告。
words.example: I need to finish my report by Friday.

words.englishDefinition: a road in a town or city, usually with buildings beside it
words.japaneseExplanation: 町や市街地の建物が並ぶ道路。
words.example: There is a small bakery across the street.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who visits
words.japaneseExplanation: 訪問する人。
words.example: We had a visitor while you were taking a shower.

words.englishDefinition: How something is done or how it happens
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かがされる方法またはそれが起こる方法。
words.example: What is going to happen to our way of life?

words.englishDefinition: A performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging
words.japaneseExplanation: 演奏家、歌手による演劇を含まない音楽の演奏。
words.example: I would like to go to the concert with you.

words.englishDefinition: The child of your aunt or uncle
words.japaneseExplanation: おじやおばの子供。
words.example: My cousin is the last person to break his promise.

words.englishDefinition: Outbuilding that serves as a shelter for a dog
words.japaneseExplanation: 犬の住まいの役割を持つ離れ家。
words.example: My dog is going into his doghouse.

words.englishDefinition: Any number of entities (members) considered as a unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 1単位として考えられるいくつかの実体（メンバー）。
words.example: How long have you been a member of this group?

words.englishDefinition: The aggregate of past events
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去の出来事の集合体。
words.example: I understand you're interested in the history of this place.

words.englishDefinition: The conventional characters of the alphabet used to represent speech
words.japaneseExplanation: 話し言葉を表すために使用される、伝統的な、体系化された記号。
words.example: We have not received a letter from him so far.

words.englishDefinition: A unit of time equal to 60 seconds or 1/60th of an hour
words.japaneseExplanation: 60秒または1/60時間と等しい時間の単位。
words.example: I had hardly waited a minute when he came.

words.englishDefinition: Engaged in by members of a profession
words.japaneseExplanation: 専門職のメンバーが従事している。
words.example: You play the guitar quite like a professional, don't you?

words.englishDefinition: In a natural state; not tamed or domesticated or cultivated
words.japaneseExplanation: 自然な状態で。抑えられない、家畜化されていない、耕作されない。
words.example: I saw the girls pick the wild flowers.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling or showing anger
words.japaneseExplanation: 怒りを感じるか、示すさま。
words.example: I was still feeling angry.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various alternatives; some other
words.japaneseExplanation: 様々な選択肢の総称。他の何かの。
words.example: I want to put off the lesson until another day.

words.englishDefinition: very pleasant to taste
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物や飲み物の味がとてもよいこと。
words.example: This soup is delicious. Can I have some more?

words.englishDefinition: Of concern to or concerning the affairs of other nations (other than your own)
words.japaneseExplanation: 他の国（自分の国以外で）の事柄に関するまたはそれの関心事。
words.example: I can't speak my own language very well, let alone foreign ones.

words.englishDefinition: Of great significance or value
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きな意義または価値。
words.example: I have to keep my mind on this important question.

words.englishDefinition: Arousing or holding the attention
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意を喚起または保持する。
words.example: I think a film is more interesting than any book.

words.englishDefinition: Make by combining materials and parts
words.japaneseExplanation: 材料および部品を合成して作る。
words.example: How long did it take you to build your house?

words.englishDefinition: to remove dirt from something
words.japaneseExplanation: 汚れを取り除いてきれいにすること。
words.example: We clean the classroom together after the lesson.

words.englishDefinition: Cause someone or something to move by driving
words.japaneseExplanation: 運転することにより誰かまたは何かを引き起こさせる。
words.example: You will be able to drive a car some day.

words.englishDefinition: Come to pass
words.japaneseExplanation: 起こる。
words.example: What if he should happen to come late?

words.englishDefinition: Recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
words.japaneseExplanation: 記憶から知識を思い浮かべる。回顧する。
words.example: I ask you to remember this once and for all.

words.englishDefinition: Go or come back to place, condition, or activity where one has been before
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前いた場所、状況または活動へ向かうまたは戻る。
words.example: You must return the ring to where it came from.

words.englishDefinition: Express in words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で表現する。
words.example: Can you make out what he is trying to say?

words.englishDefinition: Artist who composes or conducts music as a profession
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業として曲を作ったり指揮をしたりする人。
words.example: Do you know when the musician will come here?

words.englishDefinition: An announcement containing information about an event
words.japaneseExplanation: イベントについての情報を含んでいる発表。
words.example: Do you notice anything different about me?

words.englishDefinition: A special situation
words.japaneseExplanation: 特殊状況。
words.example: I got half the things you asked me to get.

words.englishDefinition: A commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)
words.japaneseExplanation: 保有者が何らかの（公共輸送機関に乗るか、一般向けの娯楽｛ごらくのような）権利があることを示している商業的な文書。
words.example: Please give me a ticket for the seven o'clock show.

words.englishDefinition: Large feline of forests in most of Asia having a tawny coat with black stripes; endangered
words.japaneseExplanation: 黒いストライプのある黄褐色の毛のアジア大部分の森に生息する大きなネコ科の動物。絶滅危ぐIB類の。
words.example: What should you not do if you meet a tiger?

words.englishDefinition: The brother of your father or mother; the husband of your aunt
words.japaneseExplanation: あなたの父または母の兄弟。あなたの叔母の夫。
words.example: My uncle is the brother of my mother.

words.englishDefinition: A computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web
words.japaneseExplanation: WWWの一連のウェブページを維持するインターネットに接続されたコンピュータ。
words.example: I found this website yesterday when I was on the internet.

words.englishDefinition: A structure consisting of a room or set of rooms at a single position along a vertical scale
words.japaneseExplanation: 縦方向の1か所に、部屋が一つあるいは一組ある建造物。
words.example: What are you doing on the floor?

words.englishDefinition: The course of existence of an individual; the actions and events that occur in living
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人の存在の時間の経過。生存中に起こるでき事や行為。
words.example: What he did cost his life and the lives of others.

words.englishDefinition: Place of business where professional or clerical duties are performed
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業上であるか事務員の義務が実行される勤務地。
words.example: I have important business to take care of in my office.

words.englishDefinition: An excavation that is (usually) filled with water
words.japaneseExplanation: （普通）水が一杯の穴。
words.example: I filled the pool with water.

words.englishDefinition: The contestant who wins the contest
words.japaneseExplanation: 競技に勝利する競技者。
words.example: I knew she would be the winner.

words.englishDefinition: A structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place
words.japaneseExplanation: 屋根と壁があり、1つの場所にほぼ永久的に立っている構造物。
words.example: We don't need more than one coffee shop in this building.

words.englishDefinition: An institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university
words.japaneseExplanation: 教育と学位授与のために創設された高等教育機関。しばしば総合大学の一部。
words.example: I often ate at that restaurant when I was a college student.

words.englishDefinition: A female human offspring
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性の子供。
words.example: I have a daughter the same age as your son.

words.englishDefinition: Depleted of strength or energy
words.japaneseExplanation: 力またはエネルギーを消耗した。
words.example: My mother was too tired, so she went to bed early.

words.englishDefinition: Being of use or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 役に立つことまたは奉仕。
words.example: I feel very useful in my own job position.

words.englishDefinition: Having or producing a comfortable and agreeable degree of heat or imparting or maintaining heat
words.japaneseExplanation: 心地よく快適な温度を有するか生み出す、または、熱を与えるか維持する。
words.example: We will keep the room warm.

words.englishDefinition: Feeling hunger; feeling a need or desire to eat food
words.japaneseExplanation: 飢えを感じるさま。食物を食べる必要または願望を感じること。
words.example: Please give me something to eat. I am so hungry.

words.englishDefinition: Having lost your bearings; confused as to time or place or personal identity
words.japaneseExplanation: 我慢を失った。時間、場所または個人的所在において困惑した。
words.example: I must make up for lost time by driving fast.

words.englishDefinition: Most important element
words.japaneseExplanation: 最も重要な要素。
words.example: We tried with might and main to break open the door.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of or existing by virtue of geographic origin
words.japaneseExplanation: 地理的起源によって存在するまたは特徴てきな。
words.example: I studied English for four years with a native speaker.

words.englishDefinition: Easily agitated
words.japaneseExplanation: 興奮しやすい。
words.example: I didn't know that you were going to be nervous.

words.englishDefinition: Be asleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 眠っている。
words.example: I wish I could sleep better and fall asleep faster.

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture or cover a surface using paint
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵の具で絵を描くことや、塗料を塗ること。
words.example: We are going to paint the classroom walls blue.

words.englishDefinition: Look attentively
words.japaneseExplanation: 注意を払って見る。
words.example: Do you want to watch the baseball game on TV?

words.englishDefinition: Be worried, concerned, anxious, troubled, or uneasy
words.japaneseExplanation: 胸を痛める、憂慮している、案じている、問題を抱えている、または不安である。
words.example: I don't think it's anything we need to worry about.

words.englishDefinition: Save from ruin, destruction, or harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 荒廃、破壊または損害から救う。
words.example: You are the only one who can save the world.

words.englishDefinition: to give something to someone in exchange for money
words.japaneseExplanation: 代金を受け取って商品などを相手に渡すこと。
words.example: They sell fresh bread at the shop near my house.

words.englishDefinition: Precipitation falling from clouds in the form of ice crystals
words.japaneseExplanation: 氷晶という形で雲から落下する降水。
words.example: I walked through the snow to my place of work.

words.englishDefinition: Gathering of producers to promote business
words.japaneseExplanation: 事業促進のための生産者たちの集まり。
words.example: We paid a fair price for it.

words.englishDefinition: The Romance language spoken in France and in countries colonized by France
words.japaneseExplanation: フランスとフランスが植民地にした国々で話されるロマンス語。
words.example: I think that French is the most beautiful language.

words.englishDefinition: The time yet to come
words.japaneseExplanation: まだ到来していない時間。
words.example: I never think about the future. It comes soon enough.

words.englishDefinition: The organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 政治体の行政部門である組織。
words.example: What do you do for the government?

words.englishDefinition: A health facility where patients receive treatment
words.japaneseExplanation: 患者が治療を受ける健康設備。
words.example: I went to the hospital to ask about his health.

words.englishDefinition: Any of various devices or contrivances that can be used to produce musical tones or sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 音楽を演奏するための道具の総称。
words.example: I don't know how to play an instrument.

words.englishDefinition: A genre of popular music that originated in New Orleans around 1900 and developed through increasingly complex styles
words.japaneseExplanation: 1900年ごろニューオーリンズで生まれ、ますます複雑なスタイルに発展したポピュラー音楽のジャンル。
words.example: I like jazz. What kind of music do you like?

words.englishDefinition: A human being
words.japaneseExplanation: 一人の人間。
words.example: Do you see that person over there?

words.englishDefinition: Dish baked in pastry-lined pan often with a pastry top
words.japaneseExplanation: 上面に練り粉をつけ、練り粉の皮を敷いた皿で焼いたもの。
words.example: You can have the rest of the pie.

words.englishDefinition: The Romance language spoken in most of Spain and the countries colonized by Spain
words.japaneseExplanation: スペインおよびその植民地で使われたロマンス語。
words.example: I know my Spanish isn't all that great.

words.englishDefinition: Edible seeds or roots or stems or leaves or bulbs or tubers or nonsweet fruits of any of numerous herbaceous plant
words.japaneseExplanation: 多数の草本植物の食用の種、根、茎、葉、球根、塊茎、あるいは甘くない果実。
words.example: You wash the vegetables and I'll wash the fruit.

words.englishDefinition: A married woman; a man's partner in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚している女性。結婚における男性のパートナー。
words.example: I slept with my wife before we were married. Did you?

words.englishDefinition: Writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)
words.japaneseExplanation: 職業的（報酬のため）に（本、物語、記事、または、そのようなものを）書く。
words.example: I knew both the writer and the book.

words.englishDefinition: A shop where books are sold
words.japaneseExplanation: 本が販売される店。
words.example: I want a book. Where is the bookstore?

words.englishDefinition: Equipment for taking photographs (usually consisting of a lightproof box with a lens at one end and light-sensitive film at the other)
words.japaneseExplanation: 写真を撮るための装置（通常、片端にレンズがついた遮光ボックスと、もう一方には感光膜から成る）。
words.example: I forgot to put film in the camera.

words.englishDefinition: Not correct; not in conformity with fact or truth
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しくない。事実または真実と符合することない。
words.example: You were on that road at the wrong time.

words.englishDefinition: Before anything else
words.japaneseExplanation: 他のいかなるもの何よりも前に。
words.example: We must, first of all, be careful of our health.

words.englishDefinition: At the time or occasion immediately following
words.japaneseExplanation: の直後の時点、あるいは出来事。
words.example: We will be studying very hard this time next year.

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: さらに。
words.example: I also found every letter he had ever written to my mother.

words.englishDefinition: Anew
words.japaneseExplanation: 改めて。
words.example: I tried to get up, but I fell down again.

words.englishDefinition: (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct
words.japaneseExplanation: （量について）不正確であるがとても正確に近い。
words.example: I looked all around, but I could see nobody there.

words.englishDefinition: Earlier in time; previously
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間的に前の。以前に。
words.example: I lost the watch I had bought the day before.

words.japanese: 一生懸命に、難しい、硬い
words.englishDefinition: Not easy; requiring great physical or mental effort to accomplish or comprehend or endure
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単でない。完成させ、理解しまたは我慢する物理的または精神的努力を必要とする。
words.example: I know this has been a hard time for you.

words.englishDefinition: Know and comprehend the nature or meaning of
words.japaneseExplanation: 本来の姿、あるいは意味を知り、理解する。
words.example: I can understand what she is saying.

words.englishDefinition: Take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
words.japaneseExplanation: 行動を行うことで、第一歩、一歩以上を踏み出す。
words.example: We will begin the party when he comes.

words.englishDefinition: Get temporarily
words.japaneseExplanation: 一時的に得る。
words.example: I ran all over town trying to borrow some money.

words.englishDefinition: Provide with a covering or cause to be covered
words.japaneseExplanation: カバーを供給するか、カバーされるようにする。
words.example: You have to cover your mouth when you're sick.

words.japanese: 逃す、乗り遅れる、寂しく思う
words.englishDefinition: Fail to attend an event or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事や活動に参加しそこなう。
words.example: I wouldn't want to miss your concert.

words.englishDefinition: Stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
words.japaneseExplanation: 1つの場所にとどまり、何かを予想する、または期待する。
words.example: I had to wait for him for five hours!

words.englishDefinition: Reach a destination; arrive by movement or progress
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的地に着く。動くことまたは前進によって到着する。
words.example: We won't be able to arrive home in time.

words.englishDefinition: Clothing in general
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的に衣服。
words.example: My father does not care about his clothes at all.

words.englishDefinition: A piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常食べ物を乗せたり出したりするのに用いる食器の1つ。
words.example: We might as well eat dog food as eat such a dish.

words.englishDefinition: The point in time at which something ends
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが終わる時期。
words.example: I won't wait for you until the end of time.

words.englishDefinition: Something that happens at a given place and time
words.japaneseExplanation: 所定の場所・時刻で起こる事。
words.example: Do you know when the event took place?

words.englishDefinition: Workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 農場の建物および耕地を一体にしたもの。
words.example: I worked a couple of years as a farm hand.

words.englishDefinition: The trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area
words.japaneseExplanation: 広く木々の密生した地域の高木やその他の植物。
words.example: You can't see the forest for the trees.

words.englishDefinition: The mother of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の母親。
words.example: My mother is my grandmother.

words.englishDefinition: A land mass (smaller than a continent) that is surrounded by water
words.japaneseExplanation: 水によって囲まれる陸の塊（大陸よりも小さい）。
words.example: I really don't think I can swim to that island.

words.englishDefinition: A periodic publication containing pictures and stories and articles of interest to those who purchase it or subscribe to it
words.japaneseExplanation: 購入、または定期購読する人にとって興味深い写真、小説、および記事を掲載する定期刊行物。
words.example: We will not add more pictures to our magazine.

words.englishDefinition: Anything that belongs to a set or class
words.japaneseExplanation: ある集合または種別に属するもの。
words.example: How long have you been a member of this group?

words.englishDefinition: A communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled
words.japaneseExplanation: 書いたり、話したり、合図したりして伝えられる（普通短い）伝達。
words.example: I think you sent that message to the wrong person.

words.englishDefinition: The natural physical world including plants and animals and landscapes etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 動植物、風景などを含む自然な物質的世界。
words.example: What is the nature of time?

words.englishDefinition: An open way (generally public) for travel or transportation
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅行や輸送用の（一般的に公の）自由な道。
words.example: What is written on the road sign? - ONE WAY.

words.englishDefinition: The act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience
words.japaneseExplanation: 聴衆に対して正式に口頭で伝達する行為。
words.example: I doubt that he can make a speech in public.

words.englishDefinition: A large self-service grocery store selling groceries and dairy products and household goods
words.japaneseExplanation: 食料雑貨および乳製品および家庭用品を販売する大きいセルフサービスの食料雑貨品店。
words.example: We see each other at the supermarket now and then.

words.englishDefinition: Indicating exactness or preciseness
words.japaneseExplanation: 正確さまたは精密度を示すこと。
words.example: I just did what my boss told me to do.

words.englishDefinition: Many times at short intervals
words.japaneseExplanation: 短い間隔で、何回も。
words.example: I often think of the place where we met each other.

words.englishDefinition: Happening at a time subsequent to a reference time
words.japaneseExplanation: 言及時の後に起こること。
words.example: You knew that sooner or later it would happen, didn't you?

words.englishDefinition: Up to the present time
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在今に至るまで。
words.example: I haven't yet had time to see about a hotel for the night.

words.englishDefinition: with another person or other people
words.japaneseExplanation: ほかの人と同じ場所で、または協力して行うこと。
words.example: Let's work together to finish this project.

words.englishDefinition: In the past
words.japaneseExplanation: 昔は。
words.example: I came to Boston a little over three years ago.

words.englishDefinition: Not ever; at no time in the past or future
words.japaneseExplanation: かつてないさま。過去または未来にすることのないさま。
words.example: I had never felt more alone than at that time.

words.englishDefinition: At any time
words.japaneseExplanation: いかなる時でも。
words.example: Do you ever get tired of being right all the time?

words.englishDefinition: Render inoperable or ineffective
words.japaneseExplanation: 実行できなくする、または効果をなくす。
words.example: How old were you when the war broke out?

words.englishDefinition: Cause to change; make different; cause a transformation
words.japaneseExplanation: 変化させる。変える。
words.example: I think that that's about to change.

words.englishDefinition: Pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives
words.japaneseExplanation: 選ぶ、多くの選択肢から選ぶ。
words.example: I had to choose between doing that or doing this.

words.englishDefinition: Receive an academic degree upon completion of one's studies
words.japaneseExplanation: 勉強の完了で学位を受ける。
words.example: I want my children to graduate from high school.

words.englishDefinition: Move out of or depart from
words.japaneseExplanation: 出て行く、または立ち去る。
words.example: I turned out the light and left the room.

words.englishDefinition: Give temporarily; let have for a limited time
words.japaneseExplanation: 一時的に与える。一定時間持たせる。
words.example: I will lend you what little money I have now.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo an emotional sensation or be in a particular state of mind
words.japaneseExplanation: 感情的な気持ちを経験する、または特定の心理状態になる。
words.example: I want them to feel what I felt.

words.englishDefinition: a connected group of railway vehicles
words.japaneseExplanation: 線路の上を走る列車や電車。
words.example: The next train leaves in ten minutes.

words.englishDefinition: A theatrical performer
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇の演技者。
words.example: Do you want to be an actor in a movie?

words.englishDefinition: the sandy or stony land beside the sea
words.japaneseExplanation: 海辺にある砂や小石の浜。
words.example: We walked along the beach after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: A visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect
words.japaneseExplanation: それらが放つ、伝導する、あるいは反射する光によって生じる、物の目で見ることのできる属性。
words.example: I like the color white.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being suitable or opportune
words.japaneseExplanation: 適当で好都合な状態。
words.example: You pay for the convenience of living near a station.

words.englishDefinition: A particular society at a particular time and place
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の時間と場所における特定の社会。
words.example: We saw the true picture of our culture.

words.englishDefinition: The supernatural being conceived as the perfect and omnipotent and omniscient originator and ruler of the universe; the object of worship in monotheistic religions
words.japaneseExplanation: 完全で、全能で、全知であり、宇宙の創始者であり支配者として考えられている超自然。一神教における崇拝の対象。
words.example: What I wouldn't give right now, great gods, to not be married!

words.englishDefinition: Athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
words.japaneseExplanation: スポーツやトレーニングの設備が揃った運動施設。
words.example: We train every day at the gym.

words.englishDefinition: A married man; a woman's partner in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚した男性。結婚によってある女性の配偶者となった人。
words.example: I am a man and my husband is also a man.

words.englishDefinition: Any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
words.japaneseExplanation: エネルギーを伝送あるいは変形して、人間の仕事をさせたり助けさせたりする機械的あるいは電気的装置一般。
words.example: I can't seem to get him to fix this machine.

words.englishDefinition: A material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses
words.japaneseExplanation: セルロースパルプで作られる素材で、主に木、古着またはある種の草から得られる。
words.example: I made a paper plane.

words.englishDefinition: An aircraft that has a fixed wing and is powered by propellers or jets
words.japaneseExplanation: 翼を固定しプロペラあるいはジェットエンジンで動く飛行機。
words.example: What time is your plane due to take off?

words.englishDefinition: The person who holds the office of head of state of the United States government
words.japaneseExplanation: 米国政府の国家元首の在職者。
words.example: I spoke with the president this morning.

words.englishDefinition: An instance of questioning
words.japaneseExplanation: 質問の例。
words.example: We talked about the question over a cup of coffee.

words.englishDefinition: Food mixtures either arranged on a plate or tossed and served with a moist dressing; usually consisting of or including greens
words.japaneseExplanation: いろいろなものを皿に盛り付けたり混ぜ合わせたりしてドレッシングを添える料理。通常、緑黄色野菜から成る、または、緑黄色野菜を含む。
words.example: How much does it cost to make a salad?

words.englishDefinition: A static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes)
words.japaneseExplanation: （特に映画からとったもので宣伝目的に使われる）静止写真。
words.example: Do you think he still wants to live with me?

words.englishDefinition: The present or immediately coming night
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在かすぐに来る夜。
words.example: I have a feeling that tonight is going to be a good night!

words.englishDefinition: Prior to a specified or implied time
words.japaneseExplanation: 指定されたか意味された時間の前に。
words.example: I must have told you that a hundred times already.

words.englishDefinition: Under normal conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の状態で。
words.example: I don't usually wait for people who show up late.

words.englishDefinition: before the usual or expected time
words.japaneseExplanation: 予定や普段の時刻より早く行うこと。
words.example: I got up early to finish my homework.

words.englishDefinition: for fewer hours than a full working week
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常より短い時間だけ働くことや、その仕事。
words.example: I have a part-time job at a bookstore.

words.englishDefinition: The latter part of the day (the period of decreasing daylight from late afternoon until nightfall)
words.japaneseExplanation: 1日の後半（午後遅く日が落ちてから夜まで）。
words.example: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

words.englishDefinition: To or in any or all places
words.japaneseExplanation: 一部のあるいは全ての場所に。
words.example: I looked for you everywhere and didn't find you.

words.englishDefinition: Select carefully from a group
words.japaneseExplanation: グループから注意深く選択する。
words.example: I could pick you up on my way to work.

words.englishDefinition: Get something; come into possession of
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを得る。所有物として手に入れる。
words.example: I hope to receive a letter from you soon.

words.englishDefinition: Pay out
words.japaneseExplanation: 支出する。
words.example: I don't have a great deal of money to spend.

words.englishDefinition: Cook and make edible by putting in a hot oven
words.japaneseExplanation: 熱いオーブンに入れて調理し、食べられるようにする。
words.example: I took a cooking class last spring and learned to bake bread.

words.englishDefinition: to make a picture using a pencil or pen
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉛筆やペンなどで絵や図を描くこと。
words.example: Can you draw a map of your neighborhood?

words.englishDefinition: Move along on skates
words.japaneseExplanation: スケート靴で先に進む。
words.example: My parents taught me to skate when I was three years old.

words.englishDefinition: Pass to the other side of
words.japaneseExplanation: その他の側面に移り変わる。
words.example: You need to turn around and go the other way.

words.englishDefinition: A sporting competition in which contestants play a series of games to decide the winner
words.japaneseExplanation: 競技者が勝者を決定するため一連の試合を行うスポーツ競争。
words.example: Our goal is to win the tournament this year.

words.englishDefinition: The waging of armed conflict against an enemy
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵に対する武力紛争の行い。
words.example: I am against the war, of course.

words.englishDefinition: The vertical dimension of extension; distance from the base of something to the top
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さの垂直の寸法。何かの底から一番上までの距離。
words.example: Could you please tell me your height and weight?

words.englishDefinition: A severe tropical cyclone usually with heavy rains and winds moving a 73-136 knots (12 on the Beaufort scale)
words.japaneseExplanation: 普通、大雨と約73から136ノットで動く風（ビューフォート風力計では12）を伴う激しい熱帯低気圧。
words.example: We are not yet in the worst of the hurricane.

words.englishDefinition: Frozen dessert containing cream and sugar and flavoring
words.japaneseExplanation: クリーム・砂糖・香料を入れた冷凍デザート。
words.example: I want to know how much ice cream you ate.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to the Olympic Games
words.japaneseExplanation: オリンピックの、または、オリンピックに関する。
words.example: I sat up last night until two o'clock watching the Olympic Games on TV.

words.englishDefinition: A ceremonial procession including people marching
words.japaneseExplanation: 行進する人々を含む儀式的な行列。
words.example: I couldn't see the parade well from where I was.

words.englishDefinition: A small adhesive token stuck on a letter or package to indicate that that postal fees have been paid
words.japaneseExplanation: 郵便の料金が払われたそれを示すために手紙か小包に貼り付けられる小さな粘着性の印。
words.example: I need to get a stamp.

words.englishDefinition: A person who works at a specific occupation
words.japaneseExplanation: ある特定の職で働く人。
words.example: Do you need a worker?

words.englishDefinition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of
words.japaneseExplanation: 呼吸に必要な気体の混合物（特に酸素）。風ができるもの。
words.example: What do I need to get some air for?

words.englishDefinition: An airfield equipped with control tower and hangars as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
words.japaneseExplanation: 旅客や貨物のための設備のみならず管制塔やハンガーなどを備えた飛行場。
words.example: How much will it cost to get to the airport?

words.englishDefinition: A wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの車輪があり、足のペダルで動く車両。
words.example: I don't like cars, so I always ride a bike.

words.englishDefinition: A restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
words.japaneseExplanation: セルフサービス形式でキャッシャーで代金を支払う。
words.example: Can you meet me in the cafeteria in ten minutes?

words.englishDefinition: A possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
words.japaneseExplanation: 状況の好ましい組み合わせによる可能性。
words.example: You never gave us a chance.

words.englishDefinition: Ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point
words.japaneseExplanation: 2本の軸が等しい長さである楕円。固定した1点から一定の距離で動く1点の作る平面曲線。
words.example: I really like him, but not his circle of friends.

words.englishDefinition: Located at a great distance in time or space or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 時間、スペース、程度において非常に距離がある。
words.example: We have far better things to do with our time.

words.englishDefinition: On one occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: ある時。
words.example: I get a call from her once in a while.

words.englishDefinition: at the time that; at what time
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜するとき」や、時を尋ねる「いつ」を表す。
words.example: Please call me when you get home.

words.englishDefinition: on the condition that; whether
words.japaneseExplanation: 条件の「もし〜なら」や「〜かどうか」を表す。
words.example: We can eat outside if the weather is nice.

words.englishDefinition: for the reason that
words.japaneseExplanation: 理由を説明する語。後ろに主語と動詞を置く。
words.example: I took the bus because it was raining.

words.englishDefinition: used to introduce the second part of a comparison
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較級の後で、比べる相手を示す。
words.example: This bag is lighter than my old one.

words.englishDefinition: up to a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: ある時まで動作や状態が続くことを表す。
words.example: The library is open until seven tonight.

words.englishDefinition: during the time that; in contrast with
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜している間に」や「一方で」を表す接続詞。
words.example: I listened to music while I cleaned my room.

words.englishDefinition: to take something to the person or place that needs it
words.japaneseExplanation: 荷物などを相手や目的地まで届けること。
words.example: Can you deliver this package to our office tomorrow?

words.englishDefinition: React verbally
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉で反応する。
words.example: What kind of questions do you want me to answer?

words.englishDefinition: Accept as true; take to be true
words.japaneseExplanation: 真実として受け取る。真実であるとみなす。
words.example: We have full reason to believe that it is true.

words.englishDefinition: Get or gather together
words.japaneseExplanation: 集合する、または集まる。
words.example: I got up and went to the window to collect my ideas.

words.englishDefinition: Be priced at
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段がつく。
words.example: I do not know how much it can cost now.

words.englishDefinition: Travel across or pass over
words.japaneseExplanation: 横切って渡るか、通り越す。
words.example: I have to cross the city every day to go to work.

words.englishDefinition: to stop being alive
words.japaneseExplanation: 命が終わること。過去形と過去分詞は died。
words.example: Plants can die if they do not get enough water.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who pays for goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品やサービスにお金を払う人。
words.example: I hope that we don't lose you as a customer.

words.englishDefinition: A series of mental images and emotions occurring during sleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 睡眠中に起こる一連の精神的イメージと感情。
words.example: I saw it all in a dream last night.

words.englishDefinition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
words.japaneseExplanation: 聴覚と平衡感覚のための感覚器官。
words.example: I see with my eyes and hear with my ears.

words.englishDefinition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
words.example: We heard the news that you had passed the exam.

words.englishDefinition: The event of something burning (often destructive)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが燃えること（たいてい破壊的）。
words.example: We lost everything in the fire.

words.englishDefinition: The number that is represented as a one followed by 6 zeros
words.japaneseExplanation: 6つのゼロの続く数として表現される数。
words.example: What would you do if you had a million dollars?

words.englishDefinition: A land mass that projects well above its surroundings; higher than a hill
words.japaneseExplanation: 周りのものを超えて目立つ土地の塊。丘より高い。
words.example: You can't get through the mountain pass in the winter.

words.englishDefinition: One side of one leaf (of a book or magazine or newspaper or letter etc.) or the written or pictorial matter it contains
words.japaneseExplanation: 1枚の葉（本または雑誌または新聞紙または手紙その他の。）の一方またはそれが含む書面にしたか絵の問題。
words.example: I turn over a page of the book.

words.englishDefinition: Large black-and-white herbivorous mammal of bamboo forests of China and Tibet; in some classifications considered a member of the bear family or of a separate family Ailuropodidae
words.japaneseExplanation: 中国とチベットの竹林に生息する、大きな白黒の草食性哺乳類。ある分類法では、クマ科の動物、もしくは別のパンダ科の動物と考えられる。
words.example: I had never seen a panda until I went to China.

words.englishDefinition: Electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い距離を転送されることができる音を電子信号に変換し、その後受信信号を音に再度変換する電子機器。
words.example: I didn't want to talk about that over the phone.

words.englishDefinition: A representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
words.japaneseExplanation: 人物あるいは場面のプリントまたは透明なスライドの形の表現。カメラで感光性材料に記録される。
words.example: I can't look at this photo without feeling very sad.

words.englishDefinition: A sign posted in a public place as an advertisement
words.japaneseExplanation: 広告として公共の場所に貼られた掲示。
words.example: What does that poster mean?

words.englishDefinition: Something presented as a gift
words.japaneseExplanation: 贈呈されるもの。
words.example: I want a present for my wife.

words.englishDefinition: A state of difficulty that needs to be resolved
words.japaneseExplanation: 解決する必要のある困難な状況。
words.example: Our problem is how to get in touch with him.

words.englishDefinition: A contest of speed
words.japaneseExplanation: スピードを争う競技。
words.example: I tried my best, but I still lost the race.

words.englishDefinition: using a method; no later than a time
words.japaneseExplanation: 手段、動作を行う人、締め切りなどを示す前置詞。
words.example: Please finish your homework by Friday.

words.englishDefinition: across or above something; more than
words.japaneseExplanation: 物を越えること、上方の位置、数量の超過などを表す。
words.example: The plane flew over our school this morning.

words.englishDefinition: in the space separating two things
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つのものの間の位置などを表す。
words.example: The bank is between the station and the library.

words.englishDefinition: at some time within a period
words.japaneseExplanation: ある期間の中で起こることを表す。後ろは名詞。
words.example: We visited my grandparents during the summer vacation.

words.englishDefinition: from a time in the past; because
words.japaneseExplanation: 時点を示すと「〜以来」。理由を示すと「〜なので」。
words.example: I have lived in this town since April.

words.englishDefinition: from one side to the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 道などの片側から反対側へ渡ること。
words.example: Please be careful when you walk across the road.

words.englishDefinition: A single person or thing
words.japaneseExplanation: 単一の人あるいは物。
words.example: I like this one best of all.

words.englishDefinition: the whole amount or every member of a group
words.japaneseExplanation: 量や集団のすべてを表す。
words.example: All of the students helped clean the classroom.

words.englishDefinition: To come or go into
words.japaneseExplanation: 来るまたは中に入る。
words.example: What is the reason you want to enter this college?

words.englishDefinition: Descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
words.japaneseExplanation: 重力の影響を受けている時、歯止めなく落下する。
words.example: I could fall in love with you all over again.

words.englishDefinition: Be engaged in a fight; carry on a fight
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦いに従事している。戦いを続ける。
words.example: You have to fight against this other woman.

words.englishDefinition: Be the source of pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 痛みの源である。
words.example: I don't want to do anything that would hurt you.

words.englishDefinition: Run for exercise
words.japaneseExplanation: 運動のために走る。
words.example: I love to jog more than anything else in the world.

words.englishDefinition: Fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense
words.japaneseExplanation: 保つこと、または維持することができない。物理的または抽象的に持つことをやめる。
words.example: I wish I could lose weight and keep it off.

words.englishDefinition: Give money, usually in exchange for goods or services
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常商品またはサービスと引きかえに、お金を与える。
words.example: I don't have any money to pay for the bus.

words.englishDefinition: A principle or condition that customarily governs behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 慣習的に行動を支配する原則あるいは条件。
words.example: I make it a rule to take a walk before breakfast.

words.englishDefinition: A garment worn around the head or neck or shoulders for warmth or decoration
words.japaneseExplanation: 暖かくするためにあるいは装飾用に頭、首、あるいは肩の回りに付ける衣類。
words.example: I took off my scarf and put it on the bed.

words.englishDefinition: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior
words.japaneseExplanation: 内部の熱核反応により生じたエネルギーを放射する、高温のガスでできた天体。
words.example: I want to make you a star here in Algeria.

words.englishDefinition: A building where theatrical performances or motion-picture shows can be presented
words.japaneseExplanation: 演劇や映画が上演される建物。
words.example: Could you show me the way to the theater?

words.englishDefinition: Clothing of distinctive design worn by members of a particular group as a means of identification
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定のグループの構成員が所属を明確にするために着る、特有のデザインの服。
words.example: You weren't wearing your uniform the last time I saw you.

words.englishDefinition: The social event at which the ceremony of marriage is performed
words.japaneseExplanation: 結婚の儀式が執り行われる社会的行事。
words.example: I want to ask them when their wedding day is.

words.englishDefinition: An unfortunate mishap; especially one causing damage or injury
words.japaneseExplanation: 不運な災難。特に損害か負傷をもたらすもの。
words.example: I want to know what caused the accident.

words.englishDefinition: A person trained to compete in sports
words.japaneseExplanation: スポーツ競技を行う訓練を受けた人。
words.example: You have the body of an athlete.

words.englishDefinition: A workplace where baked goods (breads and cakes and pastries) are produced or sold
words.japaneseExplanation: 焼き物（パン、ケーキ、焼き菓子）が作られ、売られる仕事場。
words.example: I always buy my bread from the bakery.

words.englishDefinition: A financial institution that accepts deposits and channels the money into lending activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 預金を受け付け、その金を貸付業務に回す金融機関。
words.example: I have to take some money out of the bank.

words.englishDefinition: A wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
words.japaneseExplanation: 2つの車輪があり、足のペダルで動く車両。
words.example: I will give you this bicycle as a birthday present.

words.englishDefinition: The leader of a group of people
words.japaneseExplanation: 人々の集まりの指導者。
words.example: I had to trust the captain with my life.

words.englishDefinition: A joyful occasion for special festivities to mark some happy event
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの楽しい出来事を記念した特別のお祝いの機会。
words.example: I arrived late for the celebration.

words.englishDefinition: Call up by using a cellular phone
words.japaneseExplanation: 携帯電話を用いて呼び出す。
words.example: Do you know where I put my cell phone?

words.englishDefinition: An area that is approximately central within some larger region
words.japaneseExplanation: より大きなものの内部の、ほぼ真ん中にある領域。
words.example: What train goes to the center of town?

words.englishDefinition: any person; a person whose identity is not specified
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑問文では「誰か」、否定文では「誰も」、肯定文では「誰でも」。
words.example: Does anyone know where the station is?

words.englishDefinition: used to give advice or say what is expected
words.japaneseExplanation: 助言の「〜したほうがよい」や予想を表す。後ろは動詞の原形。
words.example: You should take an umbrella with you today.

words.englishDefinition: used for past ability, possibility, or polite requests
words.japaneseExplanation: 過去の能力、可能性、丁寧な依頼を表す助動詞。
words.example: Could you help me carry this box?

words.englishDefinition: used to say that something is necessary
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜しなければならない」と義務や必要性を表す助動詞。
words.example: You must wear a seat belt in the car.

words.englishDefinition: Of or relating to or belonging to a nation or country
words.japaneseExplanation: 国または国家に属する、またはそれに関係するまたはそれの。
words.example: We took a trip to a national park.

words.englishDefinition: Overfilled or compacted or concentrated
words.japaneseExplanation: いっぱいにされるか、ぎっしり詰まるか、集中される。
words.example: I heard someone call my name in the crowded bus.

words.englishDefinition: Of or belonging to or occurring every day
words.japaneseExplanation: 毎日の、毎日に属する、または、毎日生じる。
words.example: What time of day do you go out for your daily walk?

words.englishDefinition: (of persons) excessively affected by emotion
words.japaneseExplanation: （人について）過度に感情に影響される。
words.example: I think we're all really excited about this.

words.englishDefinition: Shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険、けが、破壊または損害からの防御。
words.example: We must protect the rain forest.

words.englishDefinition: Reach a destination, either real or abstract
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的地に着く、実際のまたは抽象のいずれかの。
words.example: I want to reach the hotel before it gets dark.

words.englishDefinition: Sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、動物の動きを制御してその背中に座って旅をする。
words.example: Can you teach me how to ride a horse?

words.englishDefinition: Have in common
words.japaneseExplanation: 共通に持つ。
words.example: I would like to share a short story with you.

words.englishDefinition: Be in accord; be in agreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 一致している。合意する。
words.example: I could agree with you, but then we'd both be wrong.

words.englishDefinition: Succeed in catching or seizing, especially after a chase
words.japaneseExplanation: 追跡した後に捕獲または捕まえることに成功する。
words.example: We got to the station in time to catch the bus.

words.englishDefinition: Behave as expected during of holidays or rites
words.japaneseExplanation: 休日または儀式で予想通りに振舞う。
words.example: I want to celebrate Christmas with you.

words.englishDefinition: A period of 100 years
words.japaneseExplanation: 100年の期間。
words.example: How many years are there in a century?

words.englishDefinition: A young person of either sex
words.japaneseExplanation: 両方の性別の若者。
words.example: What was your favorite book when you were a child?

words.englishDefinition: the Chinese language; people from China
words.japaneseExplanation: 中国語、または中国の人々を表す名詞。
words.example: My friend is learning Chinese at university.

words.englishDefinition: Artifact made by weaving or felting or knitting or crocheting natural or synthetic fibers
words.japaneseExplanation: 天然繊維あるいは合成繊維を織ること、フェルトにすること、編むこと、または鉤針編みすることによって作られる人工物。
words.example: We took our clothes off and played in the street.

words.englishDefinition: An outer garment that has sleeves and covers the body from shoulder down; worn outdoors
words.japaneseExplanation: 袖を持ち肩から下に向けて体を覆う外側の衣服。屋外で着られる。
words.example: You must take your coat, in case it gets cold.

words.englishDefinition: The basic monetary unit in many countries; equal to 100 cents
words.japaneseExplanation: 多くの国で使われている通貨の基本単位。100セントと同価。
words.example: Can you help me out by giving me a dollar?

words.englishDefinition: A one-piece garment for a woman; has skirt and bodice
words.japaneseExplanation: 婦人用のワンピース。スカートと胴着の部分がある。
words.example: We came here to buy a dress for our daughter.

words.englishDefinition: An item of information that is typical of a class or group
words.japaneseExplanation: ある階級または集団の典型とされる情報の物。
words.example: Can you give an example to explain what you mean?

words.englishDefinition: The accumulation of knowledge or skill that results from direct participation in events or activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 行事や活動に直接かかわることで得た技術や知識の蓄積。
words.example: I have some experience in that area as well.

words.englishDefinition: A barrier that serves to enclose an area
words.japaneseExplanation: ある領域を囲うための障壁。
words.example: My father put a fence around the garden.

words.englishDefinition: The standard German language; developed historically from West Germanic
words.japaneseExplanation: 標準ドイツ語。歴史的に西ゲルマン語から発達した。
words.example: I feel that the German language can be very difficult.

words.englishDefinition: a year or level in school
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校での学年を表す。成績の意味でも使う。
words.example: My brother is in the fifth grade this year.

words.englishDefinition: The father of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の父親。
words.example: You look more like your grandfather than your father.

words.englishDefinition: A sandwich consisting of a fried cake of minced beef served on a bun, often with other ingredients
words.japaneseExplanation: 牛の挽肉を揚げたものを柔らかいパンにのせたもの。
words.example: I stopped for a hamburger on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: The town (or city) where you grew up or where you have your principal residence
words.japaneseExplanation: 自分が育った、あるいは主に生活していた町（あるいは市）。
words.example: What are some things you like about your hometown?

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of or peculiar to a woman
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性に特徴的な、または、女性に特有である。
words.example: I have a female dog and a female cat.

words.englishDefinition: Younger; lower in rank; shorter in length of tenure or service
words.japaneseExplanation: 年下の。階級においてより低い。
words.example: I didn't know you were still in junior high school.

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity
words.japaneseExplanation: 大音量、または激しい音により特徴づけられる、またはそれを生じる。
words.example: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.

words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of a man
words.japaneseExplanation: 男性の特性。
words.example: What would you say to sound like a male?

words.englishDefinition: Capable of happening or existing
words.japaneseExplanation: 起きるまたは存在できる。
words.example: I want to read as many English books as possible this year.

words.englishDefinition: Experiencing or showing sorrow or unhappiness
words.japaneseExplanation: 悲しみまたは不幸を経験するか、示すさま。
words.example: I felt sad and you were far away.

words.englishDefinition: Of so extreme a degree or extent
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度や範囲が非常に極端な。
words.example: I really dream of such a tree in my garden.

words.englishDefinition: not difficult
words.japaneseExplanation: あまり苦労せずにできること。
words.example: This book is easy enough for me to read.

words.englishDefinition: Hold back, as of a danger or an enemy; check the expansion or influence of
words.japaneseExplanation: 制止する、の危険のようなあるいは敵のように。それの拡張または影響を確認する。
words.example: I decided to go back to check whether I'd locked the door.

words.englishDefinition: Be in or establish communication with
words.japaneseExplanation: 連絡を確立するまたは連絡する。
words.example: Do you have a number where we can contact you?

words.englishDefinition: Regard something as probable or likely
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かに対して、起こり得る、または見込まれると見なす。
words.example: You can expect me tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Travel through the air; be airborne
words.japaneseExplanation: 空気中を移動する。空中で。
words.example: I can no more swim than I can fly.

words.englishDefinition: Act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の支配、命令または要望の見合って行動する。
words.example: You must follow the rules of the game.

words.englishDefinition: Dismiss from the mind; stop remembering
words.japaneseExplanation: 心から棄却する。覚えることを止める。
words.example: I wouldn't be able to forget you even if I tried.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move by striking
words.japaneseExplanation: 打つことで動くようにする。
words.example: I tried to hit the ball, but I couldn't.

words.englishDefinition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange
words.japaneseExplanation: データの通信や交換を容易にするためにTCP/IPネットワークプロトコルを用いた、世界的に広がったネットワークから成るコンピュータネットワーク。
words.example: You can make a computer-to-computer call on the internet for free!

words.englishDefinition: A formation of people or things one behind another
words.japaneseExplanation: 順々に後ろに並ぶ人や物の編成。
words.example: You must stand in a line to buy a ticket.

words.englishDefinition: A room in a private house or establishment where people can sit and talk and relax
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人の家や施設で人が座って話したりリラックスしたりできる部屋。
words.example: I thought I asked you to clean the living room.

words.englishDefinition: A storage compartment for clothes and valuables; usually it has a lock
words.japaneseExplanation: 服や貴重品の収納ロッカー。通例鍵が付いている。
words.example: I don't remember if I locked my locker.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who controls resources and expenditures
words.japaneseExplanation: 資産と支出を管理する人。
words.example: I cannot call the manager now. It's too late.

words.englishDefinition: The food served and eaten at one time
words.japaneseExplanation: 1回に出されて、食べる食事。
words.example: We eat a meal three times a day.

words.englishDefinition: A depository for collecting and displaying objects having scientific or historical or artistic value
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学的、歴史的、あるいは芸術的に価値のあるものを蒐集し展示するための保管所。
words.example: How much money has been spent on building the museum?

words.englishDefinition: A geometric element that has position but no extension
words.japaneseExplanation: 位置はあっても広がりを持たない幾何学的要素。
words.example: I get your point, but I still don't agree.

words.englishDefinition: Undesirable state of the natural environment being contaminated with harmful substances as a consequence of human activities
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の活動の結果として有害物質で汚染されている自然な環境の不適当な状態。
words.example: I don't go out when there's that much air pollution.

words.englishDefinition: A rational motive for a belief or action
words.japaneseExplanation: 信念または行動の合理的な動機。
words.example: We are the reason why we lost the war.

words.englishDefinition: Directions for making something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを作るための指示。
words.example: Can you teach me how to cook that recipe?

words.englishDefinition: An occasion (usually brief) for buying at specially reduced prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な割引価格で買える機会（通常短期間）。
words.example: I got it for half price at a sale.

words.englishDefinition: Two (or more) slices of bread with a filling between them
words.japaneseExplanation: 2枚（またはそれ以上）の薄切りのパンの間に詰め物をしたもの。
words.example: I forgot my lunch and bought a sandwich at school.

words.englishDefinition: A particular branch of scientific knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 科学知識の特定の領域。
words.example: I like my French class better than my science class.

words.englishDefinition: Something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)
words.japaneseExplanation: 他者から隠されたままでいるもの（特に伝えられてはならない情報）。
words.example: I think we should keep this a secret.

words.englishDefinition: High in price or charging high prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
words.example: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

words.englishDefinition: Acting or moving or capable of acting or moving quickly
words.japaneseExplanation: 迅速に作用すること、動くことあるいは、作用することと動くことが可能である。
words.example: I have to set my watch back. It's very fast.

words.englishDefinition: a small number of people or things
words.japaneseExplanation: 数えられる名詞と使う。a few は「いくつか」、few は「ほとんどない」。
words.example: I have a few questions about the homework.

words.englishDefinition: containing as much as possible; having eaten enough
words.japaneseExplanation: 空きがないことや、食べて満腹であること。
words.example: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.

words.englishDefinition: Consisting of one of two equivalent parts in value or quantity
words.japaneseExplanation: 値や量を、二つに等しく分けたうちの一つから成るさま。
words.example: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.

words.englishDefinition: weighing a lot
words.japaneseExplanation: 重さが大きく、持つのに力が必要なこと。
words.example: This bag is too heavy for me to carry.

words.englishDefinition: Longing to return home
words.japaneseExplanation: 家に帰ることを切望するさま。
words.example: Do you know what it feels like to be homesick?

words.englishDefinition: Belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の人（とくにあなた自身）のために、またはそれに属する。所有格によって先行される。
words.example: Do you make your own clothes?

words.englishDefinition: Move very fast
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に速く動く。
words.example: We have very little time, so please hurry.

words.englishDefinition: Come up with (an idea, plan, explanation, theory, or principle) after a mental effort
words.japaneseExplanation: 思考錯誤の後で思いつく（考え、計画、説明理論または主義）。
