words.example: We should invent a secret language.

words.englishDefinition: to cause a living thing to die
words.japaneseExplanation: 生き物の命を奪うこと。植物や細菌にも使う。
words.example: Too much water can kill some indoor plants.

words.englishDefinition: Place into the hands or custody of
words.japaneseExplanation: 手の中に置くまたは、の拘置。
words.example: Can you please pass me the newspaper?

words.englishDefinition: Give a performance (of something)
words.japaneseExplanation: （何かの）公演をする。
words.example: I do not like to perform in front of others.

words.englishDefinition: Move so that an opening or passage is obstructed; make shut
words.japaneseExplanation: 入り口や通路を塞ぐように移動する。閉める。
words.example: Please shut the door, it's too cold to have it open.

words.englishDefinition: to have or produce a particular smell
words.japaneseExplanation: 物から特定のにおいがすること。smell good で「よいにおいがする」。
words.example: The bread in the oven smells wonderful.

words.englishDefinition: A place within a region identified relative to a center or reference location
words.japaneseExplanation: ある範囲で中心あるいは基準の位置と相対する場所。
words.example: I wish I was by your side right now.

words.englishDefinition: A serving that has been cut from a larger portion
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きいものから一人前に切り分けたもの。
words.example: I cut myself a slice of bread and it fell on the floor.

words.englishDefinition: A book prepared for use in schools or colleges
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校または大学で使うために準備された本。
words.example: I forgot to buy the textbook.

words.englishDefinition: The means whereby some act is accomplished
words.japaneseExplanation: それによって何かが達成される手段。
words.example: Do you know what this tool is used for?

words.englishDefinition: A journey or route all the way around a particular place or area
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の場所また領域周辺の全ての旅またはルート。
words.example: I did it as part of a tour with ten other people.

words.englishDefinition: Someone who travels for pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 娯楽のために旅をする人。
words.example: How does it feel to live in a tourist town?

words.englishDefinition: The hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees
words.japaneseExplanation: 木の皮の下にある、固い繊維質の木化した物質。
words.example: You can't see the wood for the trees.

words.englishDefinition: A female actor
words.japaneseExplanation: 女性の俳優。
words.example: My best friend is going to be an actress.

words.englishDefinition: A wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)
words.japaneseExplanation: 野性的で興奮させるような仕事（必ずしも合法的であるというわけではない）。
words.example: I want to go on an adventure.

words.englishDefinition: An automatic signal (usually a sound) warning of danger
words.japaneseExplanation: 危険を警告する自動の信号（通常音）。
words.example: I went on sleeping because the alarm didn't go off.

words.englishDefinition: Meat that has been barbecued or grilled in a highly seasoned sauce
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に風味のきいたソースでバーベキューにする、またはグリルで焼いた肉。
words.example: I haven't had a barbecue for a long time.

words.englishDefinition: A room (as in a residence) containing a bathtub or shower and usually a washbasin and toilet
words.japaneseExplanation: 浴槽またはシャワーと通常洗面台とトイレを含んでいる部屋（住居のように）。
words.example: My apartment has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom.

words.englishDefinition: Someone new to a field or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: ある分野や活動に新しく入る人。
words.example: You don't look like a beginner.

words.englishDefinition: The lower side of anything
words.japaneseExplanation: あるものの下側の面。
words.example: Please write your name at the bottom of this paper.

words.englishDefinition: A structure that allows people or vehicles to cross an obstacle such as a river or canal or railway etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 川・運河・鉄道などの障害物を人や車が横断できるようにする構造物。
words.example: We weren't allowed to cross the bridge.

words.englishDefinition: Lacking self-confidence
words.japaneseExplanation: 自信がないさま。
words.example: I was very shy when I was a kid.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by absence of sound
words.japaneseExplanation: 音の欠如で、マークされます。
words.example: I kept silent because I didn't know what to say.

words.englishDefinition: Consistent with fact or reality; not false
words.japaneseExplanation: 事実か現実と一致している。間違っていない。
words.example: What he said was by no means true.

words.englishDefinition: Extraordinarily good or great ; used especially as intensifiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常に良い、または大きい。特に強意語として使用される。
words.example: I had a wonderful time when I was in Boston.

words.englishDefinition: not present where someone is expected to be
words.japaneseExplanation: いるはずの場所にいないこと。学校では欠席を表す。
words.example: Two students were absent from class yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: So lacking in interest as to cause mental weariness
words.japaneseExplanation: そのため原因精神的な疲労に関しての関心を欠くさま。
words.example: What can I do to make my life less boring?

words.englishDefinition: Physically and forcibly separated into pieces or cracked or split
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的に、強制的に、ばらばらに切り離されるか、破られるか、割られる。
words.example: I think that my leg is broken. I can't move.

words.englishDefinition: Relatively low in price or charging low prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 価格が比較的低い、または安値で課金しているさま。
words.example: I don't think it would be cheap to do that.

words.englishDefinition: Have flavor; taste of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 味がある。何かの味。
words.example: Do you want to taste my ice cream?

words.englishDefinition: Attack someone physically or emotionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 物理的または感情的にだれかを攻撃する。
words.example: We didn't intend to attack him.

words.englishDefinition: Move while supporting, either in a vehicle or in one's hands or on one's body
words.japaneseExplanation: 車両で、人手で、または、身に付けて、維持している間に移動する。
words.example: You must carry the keys with you at all times.

words.englishDefinition: Continue a certain state, condition, or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の状態、条件または活動を続ける。
words.example: We have to continue doing this until it gets done.

words.englishDefinition: Shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
words.japaneseExplanation: 悲しみ、怒りまたは痛みのために涙を流す。
words.example: I felt like crying when I heard the news.

words.englishDefinition: Do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of
words.japaneseExplanation: 処分する、破壊あるいは破滅を引き起こす。
words.example: Do you think that you need to destroy my things?

words.englishDefinition: Exchange or replace with another, usually of the same kind or category
words.japaneseExplanation: 別のものと交換する、取り替える、通常同じ種類またはカテゴリーのものと。
words.example: Could you please exchange some small change with me?

words.englishDefinition: (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team
words.japaneseExplanation: 選手やチームの指導責任者。
words.example: Do you have what it takes to be a coach?

words.englishDefinition: Light and humorous drama with a happy ending
words.japaneseExplanation: ハッピーエンドの軽くユーモラスなドラマ。
words.example: We laughed a lot during the comedy movie.

words.englishDefinition: A machine for performing calculations automatically
words.japaneseExplanation: 自動的に計算を行う機械。
words.example: We are looking for somebody who can use a computer.

words.englishDefinition: One of the large landmasses of the earth
words.japaneseExplanation: 地球の大きな広大な土地のうちの1つ。
words.example: What is the continent with the most people living on it in the world?

words.englishDefinition: Education imparted in a series of lessons or meetings
words.japaneseExplanation: 一連のレッスンまたは会議で授けられる教育。
words.example: Do you also want to take part in this course?

words.englishDefinition: A specially marked horizontal area within which a game is played
words.japaneseExplanation: ゲームが行われる水平の場所を指す。
words.example: My friends stood by me during the court case.

words.englishDefinition: Something used to beautify
words.japaneseExplanation: 美しくするために用いられるもの。
words.example: I don't really give a damn about the decoration of our wedding.

words.englishDefinition: A person qualified to practice dentistry
words.japaneseExplanation: 歯科医を開業する資格を持つ人。
words.example: I have to go to the dentist after school today.

words.englishDefinition: The act of describing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かについて説明する行為。
words.example: I don't know anyone in the city who would match this description.

words.englishDefinition: A dish served as the last course of a meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事の最後として出される一品。
words.example: My son didn't finish the dessert, so I ate it.

words.englishDefinition: The act of eating dinner
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事をする行為。
words.example: I like to eat in the dining room.

words.englishDefinition: The act of reducing the selling price of merchandise
words.japaneseExplanation: 商品の販売価格を下げる行為。
words.example: I don't think they actually get much of a discount.

words.englishDefinition: A small ring-shaped friedcake
words.japaneseExplanation: 輪形の小さい揚げ菓子。
words.example: I treated myself to a cup of coffee and a doughnut.

words.englishDefinition: Something that provides access (to get in or get out)
words.japaneseExplanation: 出入りを提供するもの（入る、または、出る）。
words.example: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.

words.englishDefinition: The totality of surrounding conditions
words.japaneseExplanation: 総体的な周囲の状況。
words.example: We do not respect the environment as much as we should.

words.englishDefinition: with many clouds in the sky
words.japaneseExplanation: 空が雲に覆われていること。
words.example: It was cloudy this morning, but now it's sunny.

words.englishDefinition: Involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
words.japaneseExplanation: 危機または危険を起こすまたはそれらを伴う。苦痛または危害を招きやすい。
words.example: I don't want to do anything that might be dangerous.

words.englishDefinition: Relatively deep or strong; affecting one deeply
words.japaneseExplanation: 比較的深い、または強いさま。深く影響するさま。
words.example: My sleep at night is not very deep.

words.englishDefinition: Easy and not involved or complicated
words.japaneseExplanation: 簡単である、そして、かかわっていない、または複雑ではない。
words.example: I read this book when I was in elementary school.

words.englishDefinition: Affording satisfaction or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 満足または喜びを与えるさま。
words.example: I wanted my life to be more enjoyable.

words.japanese: よく知っている、なじみのある
words.englishDefinition: Well known or easily recognized
words.japaneseExplanation: よく知られているか、または容易に認識される。
words.example: I was not familiar with this song.

words.englishDefinition: Recently made, produced, or harvested
words.japaneseExplanation: 最近作られた、生産された、または収穫された。
words.example: I bought some fresh bread on the way home.

words.englishDefinition: Arousing or provoking laughter
words.japaneseExplanation: 笑いを起こすか、誘うさま。
words.example: You look funny in the hat.

words.englishDefinition: Be agreeable or acceptable to
words.japaneseExplanation: 好ましいか、許容できる。
words.example: I think that you're going to fit in just fine.

words.englishDefinition: Guess correctly; solve by guessing
words.japaneseExplanation: 正しく推量する。推測することによって、解決する。
words.example: I will guess the number.

words.englishDefinition: Form a mental image of something that is not present or that is not the case
words.japaneseExplanation: 存在しない、あるいは、事実と異なる心像を形成する。
words.example: I can imagine why you don't want to talk to her.

words.englishDefinition: Bring before the public for the first time, as of an actor, song, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 最初に公の場に俳優、歌などを紹介する。
words.example: I didn't get a chance to introduce myself to her.

words.englishDefinition: Move forward by leaps and bounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 飛躍的に前進する。
words.example: I was about to jump over the wall.

words.englishDefinition: Mean or intend to express or convey
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現することまたは伝達することを意味するあるいは意図する。
words.example: What do you mean, why don't I ever say it?

words.englishDefinition: Make a request for something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かのために要求する。
words.example: Please let me know when you are ready to order.

words.englishDefinition: A piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred
words.japaneseExplanation: 実存する状況、または発生した出来事についての情報。
words.example: You must state the fact as it is.

words.englishDefinition: the part of a plant, such as an apple, that people often eat
words.japaneseExplanation: リンゴなどの果物。一般的な総称では不可算名詞。
words.example: I usually eat some fruit with my breakfast.

words.englishDefinition: A movable barrier in a fence or wall
words.japaneseExplanation: フェンスや壁についている移動可能の障害。
words.example: I got out of my car and opened the gate.

words.englishDefinition: Something acquired without compensation
words.japaneseExplanation: 保証なしで得られる何か。
words.example: My gift is in the car. I'll get it now.

words.englishDefinition: The state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it
words.japaneseExplanation: 計画が達成することを目的とし、それを達成するために意図される行動を終わらせる出来事の状態。
words.example: We won't give up when we've almost reached the goal.

words.englishDefinition: Small golden or orange-red freshwater fishes of Eurasia used as pond or aquarium fishes
words.japaneseExplanation: 池か観賞魚として使用されるユーラシアの小さい金色の、または、オレンジ赤の淡水魚。
words.example: My goldfish looks sick. I wonder what's wrong with it.

words.englishDefinition: Pain in the head caused by dilation of cerebral arteries or muscle contractions or a reaction to drugs
words.japaneseExplanation: 脳動脈の拡張、筋肉収縮、薬反応による頭痛。
words.example: Do you have something to make this headache go away?

words.englishDefinition: A healthy state of wellbeing free from disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 病気をしない幸せな健康な状態。
words.example: You should take care of your health and well-being.

words.englishDefinition: A local and well-defined elevation of the land
words.japaneseExplanation: 土地の部分的な、はっきりした隆起。
words.example: Our house is at the very top of the hill.

words.englishDefinition: an activity you enjoy doing in your free time
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由な時間に楽しむ趣味。
words.example: My favorite hobby is taking photos of birds.

words.englishDefinition: a stay in a local family's home, often while studying abroad
words.japaneseExplanation: 留学などで現地の家庭に滞在すること。
words.example: My homestay family helped me practice English every day.

words.englishDefinition: trousers made from strong cotton cloth called denim
words.japaneseExplanation: デニム地のズボン。a pair of jeans で一本。
words.example: I bought a new pair of jeans yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: Metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated
words.japaneseExplanation: 錠に差し込んだとき錠前のメカニズムが回転するように型取られた金属器具。
words.example: I must have lost my key along the way.

words.englishDefinition: A young person of either sex
words.japaneseExplanation: 両方の性別の若者。
words.example: I just want to go home and see my wife and the kids.

words.englishDefinition: One thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
words.japaneseExplanation: 1,000グラム。国際単位系で採用されている質量の基本単位。
words.example: I want to buy a kilogram of that.

words.englishDefinition: Any living or extinct member of the family Hominidae characterized by superior intelligence, articulate speech, and erect carriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 優れた知性、明晰に聞き取れる言葉と垂直の歩行で特徴づけられるヒト科の生きているか絶滅した一部のいずれか。
words.example: I want you to live more like a human being.

words.englishDefinition: a smaller amount or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 量や程度がより少ないこと。主に数えられない名詞と使う。
words.example: I want to spend less time on my phone.

words.englishDefinition: Not wide
words.japaneseExplanation: 広くない。
words.example: We have to find a way to narrow down the list.

words.englishDefinition: Being complete of its kind and without defect or blemish
words.japaneseExplanation: その種で完全な、または欠陥または傷のない。
words.example: You don't fall in love with somebody because he's perfect.

words.englishDefinition: Having little money or few possessions
words.japaneseExplanation: お金または所有物がほとんどないさま。
words.example: I gave the poor boy what little money I had with me.

words.englishDefinition: Not private; open to or concerning the people as a whole
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人的でない。全体の人に対してまたはそれに関して。
words.example: I went to a public garden to rest.

words.englishDefinition: Showing mental alertness and calculation and resourcefulness
words.japaneseExplanation: 精神的な機敏さと計算と臨機応変さを示すさま。
words.example: I thought that you were smart enough to know better.

words.englishDefinition: Occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常の習慣または手順に従って起こる、遭遇する、経験する、あるいはしばしば観察されるさま。
words.example: I arrived late because I didn't get up at my usual time.

words.englishDefinition: Move with force, "He pushed the table into a corner"
words.japaneseExplanation: 力による動き、。
words.example: Please push the table over this way.

words.englishDefinition: Become less tense, rest, or take one's ease
words.japaneseExplanation: 緊張がほぐれ、休止し安らかになる。
words.example: How do you like to relax after a long day?

words.englishDefinition: Traverse or travel on (a body of water)
words.japaneseExplanation: （水域の上を）渡るまたは行く。
words.example: Do you know how to sail a boat?

words.englishDefinition: Help to some food; help with food or drink
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物を手にとる。食べモノと飲物をとる。
words.example: I used to serve food at the soup kitchen around the corner.

words.englishDefinition: Shake (a body part) to communicate a greeting, feeling, or cognitive state
words.japaneseExplanation: （体の一部）を揺らして、挨拶、感情、または認識状態を伝える。
words.example: I have to shake hands with the President.

words.englishDefinition: Utter in a loud voice; talk in a loud voice (usually denoting characteristic manner of speaking)
words.japaneseExplanation: 大声で話す。大きな声で話す（通常、特徴的な話し方を示して）。
words.example: You don't have to shout. I can hear you.

words.englishDefinition: Glide down a snow-covered slope while standing on a board
words.japaneseExplanation: ボードの上に立った状態で、雪で覆われた斜面を滑り下りる。
words.example: I want to learn how to snowboard.

words.englishDefinition: A room equipped for preparing meals
words.japaneseExplanation: 食事を用意するための部屋。
words.example: My apartment has a living room, a bedroom, a kitchen and a bathroom.

words.englishDefinition: The land on which real estate is located
words.japaneseExplanation: 不動産が所在する土地。
words.example: Gustavo built a house on a land of his own.

words.englishDefinition: A systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols
words.japaneseExplanation: 音または慣習的記号を用いたコミュニケーションの体系的な手段。
words.example: I wish I could speak all the languages of the world.

words.englishDefinition: The collection of rules imposed by authority
words.japaneseExplanation: 行政当局によって課された規則の集まり。
words.example: I do not respect the law.

words.englishDefinition: A professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
words.japaneseExplanation: 図書館学の教育を受け図書館業務に携わる専門家。
words.example: I think the fact that I'm friends with the librarian says something about me.

words.englishDefinition: A distinguishing symbol
words.japaneseExplanation: 区別する記号。
words.example: How do you plan on making your mark on the world?

words.englishDefinition: The head of a city government
words.japaneseExplanation: 市行政の長。
words.example: My uncle is the mayor of our city.

words.englishDefinition: The flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food
words.japaneseExplanation: 食料として使われる動物（魚と鳥とカタツムリを含む）の肉。
words.example: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.

words.englishDefinition: An award for winning a championship or commemorating some other event
words.japaneseExplanation: 選手権に勝つか、または他のでき事を記念するための賞。
words.example: I heard they gave you a medal.

words.englishDefinition: Jewelry consisting of a cord or chain (often bearing gems) worn about the neck as an ornament (especially by women)
words.japaneseExplanation: 装飾（特に女性によって）として首につけられるコードまたはチェーン（しばしば、宝石をつけている）からなる宝石。
words.example: I know what that necklace means to Elias.

words.englishDefinition: One skilled in caring for young children or the sick (usually under the supervision of a physician)
words.japaneseExplanation: （通常は医者の指示で）幼児または病人を看護するのに熟練した人。
words.example: You look a little young to be a nurse.

words.englishDefinition: Creating a picture with paints
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵の具で絵を作成すること。
words.example: I still think we should've bought the painting you liked.

words.englishDefinition: A flat cake of thin batter fried on both sides on a griddle
words.japaneseExplanation: 鉄板の上で両側で揚げられる1個の平らなやせたバッター。
words.example: I didn't find the pancake.

words.englishDefinition: The property of having material worth (often indicated by the amount of money something would bring if sold)
words.japaneseExplanation: 物質的な価値をもつという特質（しばしば、何かが売られたときにもたらす金額によって表される）。
words.example: I wonder if this is worth the price they're asking.

words.englishDefinition: a planned piece of work with a particular purpose
words.japaneseExplanation: 目的を達成するために計画して進める仕事や課題。
words.example: Our class is working on a project about recycling.

words.englishDefinition: Having great (or a certain) extent from one side to the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 左右に大きな（あるいは、特定の）範囲を持つさま。
words.example: Do you think the road is wide enough for cars?

words.englishDefinition: Primarily temporal sense; indicating or being or seeming to be limited in duration
words.japaneseExplanation: 主に一時的な感覚。期間の制限を示している、である、あるいは、のように見える。
words.example: I would like to share a short story with you.

words.englishDefinition: bright with sunshine
words.japaneseExplanation: 日が照って晴れていること。
words.example: It's sunny today, so let's play outside.

words.englishDefinition: Without any others being included or involved
words.japaneseExplanation: 含まれるまたは関係する他のものなしで。
words.example: Do you prefer to work alone or with others?

words.englishDefinition: At the present or from now on; usually used with a negative
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在において、または今から。
words.example: Our children don't live here anymore.

words.englishDefinition: in addition to or different from what was mentioned
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑問詞や someone などの後で「ほかに」を表す。
words.example: Would you like anything else with your lunch?

words.englishDefinition: After an unspecified period of time or an especially long delay
words.japaneseExplanation: 不特定の期間か特に長い遅れの後に。
words.example: I finally feel like I can take some time off.

words.englishDefinition: possibly; perhaps
words.japaneseExplanation: 確実ではない可能性を表す「たぶん」「もしかすると」。
words.example: Maybe we can go to the beach tomorrow.

words.englishDefinition: Take without the owner's consent
words.japaneseExplanation: 持ち主の同意なしに取る。
words.example: We always knew he would steal from the store.

words.englishDefinition: Propel through the air
words.japaneseExplanation: 空気中で推進する。
words.example: My wife asked me to throw this old hat away.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to become awake or conscious
words.japaneseExplanation: 目が覚める、意識がある。
words.example: Please wake me at six am.

words.englishDefinition: used to greet someone arriving somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 人を迎えるときの「ようこそ」という挨拶。
words.example: Welcome to our school! Let me show you around.

words.englishDefinition: Be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: （ミーティング、礼拝、大学）等に出席する。
words.example: I got up early in order to attend the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Postpone indefinitely or annul something that was scheduled
words.japaneseExplanation: 予定されていたものを、無期限に延期する、または取り消す。
words.example: We had to cancel the meeting.

words.englishDefinition: Move with difficulty, by grasping
words.japaneseExplanation: 掴むことで、どうにか移動する。
words.example: I loved to climb trees when I was a kid.

words.englishDefinition: Make a promise or commitment
words.japaneseExplanation: 約束する、または、誓約する。
words.example: Please promise me that you'll never lie to me again.

words.englishDefinition: The only fertile female in a colony of social insects such as bees and ants and termites; its function is to lay eggs
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会性昆虫、例えばミツバチ、アリ、シロアリの群れの唯一の繁殖力のある雌。その役目は卵を産むこと。
words.example: I remember that I met the queen.

words.englishDefinition: Freedom from activity (work or strain or responsibility)
words.japaneseExplanation: （仕事や緊張、責任など）行動からの解放。
words.example: You worked a lot, you need to take a rest.

words.englishDefinition: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
words.japaneseExplanation: 固い統合鉱物質の塊か固まり。
words.example: We found ourselves between a rock and a hard place.

words.englishDefinition: A school task performed by a student to satisfy the teacher
words.japaneseExplanation: 先生を満足させるために生徒が行う学習作業。
words.example: Could you please help me with my schoolwork right now?

words.englishDefinition: Literary fantasy involving the imagined impact of science on society
words.japaneseExplanation: 社会に対する科学の想像上の衝撃を含んだ文学的なファンタジー。
words.example: I think that most old people don't understand about what science fiction is.

words.englishDefinition: A distinct region or subdivision of a territorial or political area or community or group of people
words.japaneseExplanation: 地域的、政治的な区域や共同体、人々の集合の明確な区分。
words.example: I asked for a seat in the no-smoking section.

words.englishDefinition: A string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language
words.japaneseExplanation: 言語の文法規則を満たす一連の語。
words.example: How do I change the language of a sentence?

words.englishDefinition: A perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)
words.japaneseExplanation: 即座に明らかにならないものの知覚できる手がかり（何かが起きたはっきりと見える手がかりとして）。
words.example: My wife gave me a sign from across the room.

words.japanese: 男性への丁寧な呼びかけ
words.englishDefinition: Term of address for a man
words.japaneseExplanation: 男性に対する呼びかけの言葉。
words.example: I can't tell you that, sir. It's a secret.

words.englishDefinition: A light informal meal
words.japaneseExplanation: 気軽な軽食。
words.example: I had a snack before I went back to work.

words.englishDefinition: Food prepared by stewing especially meat or fish with vegetables
words.japaneseExplanation: 肉や魚と野菜をとろ火で煮た料理。
words.example: I will go to buy the meat for the stew.

words.englishDefinition: A crocheted or knitted garment covering the upper part of the body
words.japaneseExplanation: 上体を覆うかぎ針編みあるいはメリヤスの衣服。
words.example: I think that this sweater will look good on you.

words.englishDefinition: An organized structure for arranging or classifying
words.japaneseExplanation: 整理や分類のための整った構造。
words.example: I don't like it either, but that's just the way the system works.

words.englishDefinition: Electronic equipment that converts sound into electrical signals that can be transmitted over distances and then converts received signals back into sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 長い距離を転送されることができる音を電子信号に変換し、その後受信信号を音に再度変換する電子機器。
words.example: I talked with him about it over the telephone.

words.englishDefinition: (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished; all but
words.japaneseExplanation: （行動または状態について）少し足りない、または、完全に終わっていない。ほとんど。
words.example: I have a car, but I almost never use it.

words.englishDefinition: With ease ('easy' is sometimes used informally for 'easily')
words.japaneseExplanation: 容易さをもって。
words.example: I hope that he will find his way easily.

words.japanese: どちらでも、どちらかの
words.englishDefinition: the one or the other of two
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つのうちのどちらか、またはどちらでもよいことを表す。
words.example: You can use either pen for the test.

words.englishDefinition: To a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常よりも目立って大きな程度にまたは範囲に。
words.example: My wife makes me happy, especially when she isn't home.

words.englishDefinition: On the inside
words.japaneseExplanation: 内から。
words.example: I wasn't able to see who was inside the car.

words.englishDefinition: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree
words.japaneseExplanation: 適度に十分な範囲、または程度。
words.example: I went to a pretty big school.

words.englishDefinition: With sincerity; without pretense
words.japaneseExplanation: 誠実さをもって。見せかけなしで。
words.example: I sincerely hope that never happens to him.

words.englishDefinition: On certain occasions or in certain cases but not always
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の機会、あるいは特定の場合においてしかし、常にではない。
words.example: My little sister sometimes wished she was a boy.

words.englishDefinition: Separate with or as if with an instrument
words.japaneseExplanation: 器具であるいは器具を用いたかのように分ける。
words.example: You should cut up your meat before you eat it.

words.englishDefinition: Plan something for a specific role or purpose or effect
words.japaneseExplanation: 特殊の役割、目的または効果のために何かを計画する。
words.example: I am looking for friends who can design immediately.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to be hanging or suspended
words.japaneseExplanation: つり下げる、またはぶら下げる。
words.example: I wonder where to hang the picture he gave me.

words.englishDefinition: Deliver a sharp blow or push :"He knocked the glass clear across the room"
words.japaneseExplanation: 鋭い一撃を与える、あるいは押す：。
words.example: I was just about to knock when the door opened.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move; cause to be in a certain position or condition
words.japaneseExplanation: 移動させる。ある位置または状態にさせる。
words.example: Please let me tell you a little bit about this position.

words.englishDefinition: Sleep longer than intended
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図するより長い睡眠。
words.example: How did I oversleep even though I went to bed early?!

words.englishDefinition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
words.example: I have to prepare to go to school.

words.englishDefinition: The cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100
words.japaneseExplanation: 10と100の積である基数。
words.example: I still have a thousand things to do.

words.englishDefinition: An illusory feat; considered magical by naive observers
words.japaneseExplanation: 幻影的な妙技。だまされやすい観察者は、魔法であると考える。
words.example: I know that you are up to some trick.

words.englishDefinition: A subdivision of a particular kind of thing
words.japaneseExplanation: ある種のものの下位区分。
words.example: What would you do in this type of situation?

words.englishDefinition: The visual percept of a region
words.japaneseExplanation: ある区域の視覚イメージ。
words.example: I built a house with a view of the mountain.

words.englishDefinition: A community of people smaller than a town
words.japaneseExplanation: 町より小さい人々のコミュニティ。
words.example: I don't live in a village. I live in a town.

words.englishDefinition: A person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)
words.japaneseExplanation: （レストランなどで）給仕をする仕事の人。
words.example: I asked the waiter to see about getting us a better table.

words.englishDefinition: A pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money
words.japaneseExplanation: 書類と紙幣を保持するためのポケットサイズのケース。
words.example: How much money do you have in your wallet right now?

words.englishDefinition: A glass or plastic vessel used for storing drinks or other liquids; typically cylindrical without handles and with a narrow neck that can be plugged or capped
words.japaneseExplanation: 飲物または他の液体を貯蔵するために使用されたガラスまたはプラスチック入れ物。主として円筒状で、取っ手はなく、細い首がついていて、栓をするか、蓋をすることができる。
words.example: Please don't drink from the bottle.

words.englishDefinition: An acquaintance that you go to school with
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ学校の知り合い。
words.example: My sister got married with her classmate from high school.

words.englishDefinition: A room in a school where lessons take place
words.japaneseExplanation: 学校で授業の行われる部屋。
words.example: I stayed after school to help clean the classroom.

words.englishDefinition: The basic unit of length adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites (approximately 1.094 yards)
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さの基本単位で国際単位系で採用されている（約1.094ヤード）。
words.example: We read the meter once every two months.

words.englishDefinition: A recording of both the visual and audible components (especially one containing a recording of a movie or television program)
words.japaneseExplanation: 映像部分と音声部分の両方の記録媒体（特に映画またはテレビ番組の記録媒体を含んでいるもの）。
words.example: I like that video game. And only that video game.

words.englishDefinition: Any specific behavior
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の行動。
words.example: What activity do you spend most of your time doing?

words.englishDefinition: The place where a person or organization can be found or communicated with
words.japaneseExplanation: 個人や組織が所在し、連絡をとれる場所。
words.example: I can't for the life of me remember her address.

words.englishDefinition: A fully developed person from maturity onward
words.japaneseExplanation: 進んで成熟からの十分に発達した人。
words.example: I talked about how I learned Berber as an adult.

words.englishDefinition: two times
words.japaneseExplanation: 回数が二回であること。量の二倍も表せる。
words.example: I practice the piano twice a week.

words.englishDefinition: To or in a foreign country
words.japaneseExplanation: 外国の、または外国で。
words.example: I had never been abroad before, so everything seemed strange to me.

words.englishDefinition: At or in the front
words.japaneseExplanation: 前面のまたは前面で。
words.example: I can see so much light ahead of me.

words.englishDefinition: With little expenditure of money
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんどない費用を伴う。
words.example: I found out where to buy fruit cheaply.

words.englishDefinition: By good fortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸運にも、運よく。
words.example: I could have been injured, but luckily I wasn't.

words.englishDefinition: Some unspecified time in the future
words.japaneseExplanation: 将来のある不特定の時。
words.example: I will get even with you someday. Remember that.

words.englishDefinition: Without deviation
words.japaneseExplanation: 逸脱なしで。
words.example: I went straight to the post office.

words.englishDefinition: Happening unexpectedly
words.japaneseExplanation: 思いがけなく起こること。
words.example: I had been working for two hours when I suddenly felt sick.

words.englishDefinition: Raise the level or amount of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの水準を上げるか、または量を増やす。
words.example: Do you really want to raise these children by yourself?

words.englishDefinition: To say, state, or perform again
words.japaneseExplanation: かさねて言う、述べる、または行う。
words.example: Could you please repeat it once again?

words.englishDefinition: Move upward
words.japaneseExplanation: 上方に動く。
words.example: We are waiting for the sun to rise.

words.englishDefinition: Give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
words.japaneseExplanation: ある印象を与える、またはある外観を持つ。
words.example: You don't seem to like to do that very much.

words.englishDefinition: Change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: しばしば喜びを示すために、唇を広げて表情を変える。
words.example: You ought to smile more often.

words.englishDefinition: Make physical contact with, come in contact with
words.japaneseExplanation: と身体的に接触する、と接触する。
words.example: I know that you still want to touch my hand.

words.englishDefinition: Have a wish or desire to know something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを知ろうとする願望または欲望を持つ。
words.example: I had to wonder what the future held for the two of us.

words.englishDefinition: How long something has existed
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが、どれくらい存在したか。
words.example: How are you doing? I haven't seen you for an age!

words.englishDefinition: A suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常アパートの階全部の部屋の一そろい。
words.example: Do you live in a house or an apartment?

words.englishDefinition: A tank or pool or bowl filled with water for keeping live fish and underwater animals
words.japaneseExplanation: 生きた魚と水中の動物を維持しておく水のあるタンク、プールまたは鉢。
words.example: I only have three fish in my aquarium now.

words.englishDefinition: A human limb; technically the part of the superior limb between the shoulder and the elbow but commonly used to refer to the whole superior limb
words.japaneseExplanation: 人間の手足。専門的には肩と肘の間の上肢の部分、しかし普通上肢全体を指すのに用いられる。
words.example: I saw him walking with a book under his arm.

words.englishDefinition: The quantity contained in a basket
words.japaneseExplanation: 1かごに入れられる量。
words.example: I take a basket and a shopping bag with me.

words.englishDefinition: A hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war
words.japaneseExplanation: 戦争中の、敵対する軍事力との対立的な会議。
words.example: We have lost a battle, but we will win the war.

words.englishDefinition: Hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
words.japaneseExplanation: 進歩か達成を妨げるか、または防ぐ。
words.example: I don't know how they were supposed to block that.

words.englishDefinition: The entire structure of an organism (an animal, plant, or human being)
words.japaneseExplanation: 有機体の全構造（動物、植物または人間）。
words.example: My body does not look human.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of providing goods and services involving financial and commercial and industrial aspects
words.japaneseExplanation: 財政、商業、産業の面を含む、財貨とサービスを供給する活動。
words.example: I will be taking care of your business from now on.

words.englishDefinition: An electrical switch operated by pressing
words.japaneseExplanation: ボタンを押して操作する電気のスイッチ。
words.example: I wonder what would happen if I pushed this button.

words.englishDefinition: The overhead upper surface of a covered space
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋の内側の頭上の裏張り。
words.example: How long would it take you to paint the ceiling?

words.englishDefinition: A metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter
words.japaneseExplanation: 長さのメートル法単位で1メートルの百分の1に同じ。
words.example: There's not a centimeter of earth my foot hasn't touched.

words.englishDefinition: A formal event performed on a special occasion
words.japaneseExplanation: 特別な機会にとり行われる公式行事。
words.example: I don't want to take part in the ceremony.

words.englishDefinition: A professional cook
words.japaneseExplanation: プロのコック。
words.example: How many years did you work as a chef?

words.englishDefinition: A small room (or recess) or cabinet used for storage space
words.japaneseExplanation: 収納用に使われる小さな部屋（あるいは奥まった所）またはキャビネット。
words.example: My closet is quite small.

words.englishDefinition: following the length or direction of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 道や川などに沿って進むことを表す。
words.example: We walked along the river after lunch.

words.englishDefinition: next to someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や物のすぐ横にある位置を表す。
words.example: Please put your bag beside the desk.

words.englishDefinition: in opposition to; touching and supported by
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜に反対して」「〜に接して」などを表す前置詞。
words.example: Our team is playing against theirs on Saturday.

words.englishDefinition: at the back of something
words.japaneseExplanation: 物や人の後ろ側にあることを表す。
words.example: My bike is behind the school building.

words.englishDefinition: not having or doing something
words.japaneseExplanation: 「〜なしで」を表す。後ろは名詞または動名詞。
words.example: I cannot make this cake without some eggs.

words.englishDefinition: any thing; a thing whose identity is not specified
words.japaneseExplanation: 疑問文では「何か」、否定文では「何も」、肯定文では「何でも」。
words.example: Do you need anything from the supermarket?

words.englishDefinition: the two people or things together
words.japaneseExplanation: 二人または二つの両方を表す。
words.example: Both of my parents enjoy cooking at home.

words.englishDefinition: a thing that is not named or identified
words.japaneseExplanation: 具体的に名前を言わずに「何か」を表す。
words.example: Let's find something fun to do this weekend.

words.englishDefinition: the same female person as the subject
words.japaneseExplanation: 主語の女性と同じ人を指す。by herself は「一人で」。
words.example: She made this birthday cake all by herself.

words.englishDefinition: not anything
words.japaneseExplanation: 「何も〜ない」を表す否定の代名詞。
words.example: There is nothing in this box.

words.englishDefinition: a person whose identity is not specified
words.japaneseExplanation: 名前や正体を具体的に示さずに「誰か」を表す。
words.example: Someone left a notebook on the desk.

words.englishDefinition: In a state of sleep
words.japaneseExplanation: 睡眠状態で。
words.example: We talked all night and then we fell asleep.

words.englishDefinition: Emitting or reflecting light readily or in large amounts
words.japaneseExplanation: 光をすぐに、あるいは大量に発する、または反射するさま。
words.example: Do you have a bright light for reading?

words.englishDefinition: Exercising caution or showing care or attention
words.japaneseExplanation: 警戒する、留意または注意を示すさま。
words.example: You must be very careful when you do that.

words.englishDefinition: In or near a center or constituting a center; the inner area
words.japaneseExplanation: 中心の中またはそれに近い、または中心をなす。内面積。
words.example: Can you point me in the direction of the central station?

words.englishDefinition: Mentally quick and resourceful
words.japaneseExplanation: 知的で頭の回転が速く、機知に富む。
words.example: You are too clever not to solve the hard problem.

words.englishDefinition: A place off to the side of an area
words.japaneseExplanation: ある領域の外れの場所。
words.example: Our favorite place to eat is that small restaurant on the corner.

words.englishDefinition: The attire worn in a play or at a fancy dress ball
words.japaneseExplanation: 劇や仮装舞踏会で身につける服装。
words.example: I know I look like a gift box in this costume.

words.englishDefinition: Accepted or habitual practice
words.japaneseExplanation: 受け入れられることまたは慣習。
words.example: I looked up where this custom comes from.

words.englishDefinition: A large retail store organized into departments offering a variety of merchandise; commonly part of a retail chain
words.japaneseExplanation: 種々の品物を提供するデパート形式に組織された大型小売り店舗。普通小売りチェーンの一部。
words.example: You can buy almost everything in the big department store.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being unlike or dissimilar
words.japaneseExplanation: 似ていない性質。
words.example: What is the difference between a table and a chair?

words.englishDefinition: Member of a board of directors
words.japaneseExplanation: 理事会の一員。
words.example: I want to see the director of the company.

words.englishDefinition: A retail shop where medicine and other articles are sold
words.japaneseExplanation: 薬品やその他の商品が売られている小売り店。
words.example: I have a part-time job at a drugstore.

words.englishDefinition: A rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体の体温が上がること。しばしば感染症の症状。
words.example: I had a little bit of a fever this morning.

words.englishDefinition: A region in which active military operations are in progress
words.japaneseExplanation: 活動中の軍事作戦が進行中の地域。
words.example: My son is working hard on the field right now.

words.englishDefinition: A diagram or picture illustrating textual material
words.japaneseExplanation: 本文を説明する図表や写真。
words.example: How do you eat like that and keep your figure?

words.englishDefinition: An instance of traveling by air
words.japaneseExplanation: 飛行機で旅をすること。
words.example: I had to book a flight for him.

words.englishDefinition: Furnishings that make a room or other area ready for occupancy
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋または他のエリアを居住できるようにする道具。
words.example: I want to move the furniture in the room.

words.englishDefinition: Food that is discarded (as from a kitchen)
words.japaneseExplanation: （台所などから）捨てられる食べ物。
words.example: I saw a man yesterday eating from a garbage can.

words.englishDefinition: A male grandchild
words.japaneseExplanation: 男の孫。
words.example: My grandson is seven years old. I love him very much.

words.englishDefinition: Street names for marijuana
words.japaneseExplanation: マリファナの通称。
words.example: We walked to the park and sat on the grass.

words.englishDefinition: Play a role or part
words.japaneseExplanation: 役割を果たす、役を演じる。
words.example: I feel it's still not too late to act.

words.englishDefinition: Make an addition (to); join or combine or unite with others; increase the quality, quantity, size or scope of
words.japaneseExplanation: 追加する（に対して）。加わるか、組み合わさるか、または他と結合する。
words.example: We didn't need to add flowers to the car to make it beautiful.

words.japanese: 現れる、〜のように見える
words.englishDefinition: Come into sight or view
words.japaneseExplanation: 見えてくるかあるいは見える。
words.example: My father is to appear on TV tonight.

words.englishDefinition: Take into custody
words.japaneseExplanation: 保護する。
words.example: I doubt that the police are going to arrest Tom.

words.englishDefinition: Come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor
words.japaneseExplanation: 沸点に達し、液体から気体へ変化する。
words.example: You should boil this water before you drink it.

words.englishDefinition: Undergo combustion
words.japaneseExplanation: 燃焼を経る。
words.example: I didn't think the house would burn down so quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally
words.japaneseExplanation: 引き起こす。常に意図的というわけではなく、生起させるまたは生じさせる。
words.example: I don't want to cause an accident.

words.japanese: 応援する、歓声を上げる
words.englishDefinition: Give encouragement to
words.japaneseExplanation: 励ましを与える。
words.example: We tried to cheer him up by taking him out.

words.japanese: せる 連絡を取る(with〜)、伝える(to〜)
words.englishDefinition: Transmit information
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報を伝達する。
words.example: I want to be able to communicate in French.

words.englishDefinition: Exercise authoritative control or power over
words.japaneseExplanation: 権威ある支配、または力を行使する。
words.example: You shouldn't allow your boyfriend to control your life.

words.englishDefinition: Make more attractive by adding ornament, colour, etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 飾り、色などを追加することによってより魅力的にする。
words.example: Can you help us to decorate the party room?

words.englishDefinition: Direct in spatial dimensions; proceeding without deviation or interruption; straight and short
words.japaneseExplanation: 空間次元に向かっている。逸脱または中断なしで進行すること。
words.example: Can you direct me to the train station?

words.englishDefinition: Get lost, as without warning or explanation
words.japaneseExplanation: 道に迷う、警告あるいは説明なしで。
words.example: My money seems to disappear by the end of the month.

words.englishDefinition: Discover or determine the existence, presence, or fact of
words.japaneseExplanation: 生存、存在または、の事実を発見するまたは断定する。
words.example: We had to discover that the hard way.

words.englishDefinition: Be a guiding or motivating force or drive
words.japaneseExplanation: 案内する、強く動機するあるいは駆り立てる。
words.example: I don't know who should guide me.

words.englishDefinition: An interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open
words.japaneseExplanation: 部屋に面する屋内の通路または廊下。
words.example: My teacher was in the hallway, talking to another teacher.

words.englishDefinition: A man distinguished by exceptional courage and nobility and strength
words.japaneseExplanation: 一際優れた勇気、高潔さ、強さで秀でた男性。
words.example: I don't want to be a hero.

words.englishDefinition: Leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure
words.japaneseExplanation: 労働を離れた余暇時間で、休息または娯楽に用いられる。
words.example: We want to have our holiday on an island this summer.

words.englishDefinition: The line at which the sky and Earth appear to meet
words.japaneseExplanation: 空と大地が接しているように見える線。
words.example: Do you see a ship on the horizon?

words.englishDefinition: Impairment of normal physiological function affecting part or all of an organism
words.japaneseExplanation: 生物の全体、あるいは一部に影響する生理学的機能が正常に働かないこと。
words.example: Please don't let him know the real name of his illness.

words.englishDefinition: A database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)
words.japaneseExplanation: 規則正しく配列した項目（名前または案件）を含むデータベース。
words.example: I wonder why they left my name off the list.

words.englishDefinition: Something that is remembered
words.japaneseExplanation: 覚えていること。
words.example: My memory failed me. I just couldn't remember his name.

words.englishDefinition: An intermediate part or section
words.japaneseExplanation: ある区分けの中間の部分。
words.example: Our car broke down in the middle of the street.

words.englishDefinition: 12 o'clock at night; the middle of the night
words.japaneseExplanation: 夜の12時。夜中。
words.example: I stayed up until after midnight last night.

words.englishDefinition: Representation of something (sometimes on a smaller scale)
words.japaneseExplanation: （時に縮小された規模での）物の表現。
words.example: I know that I haven't lived the model life.

words.englishDefinition: A play or film whose action and dialogue is interspersed with singing and dancing
words.japaneseExplanation: 歌と踊りを交えた動作や会話が特徴の演劇あるいは映画作品。
words.example: I can play the musical paper for you.

words.englishDefinition: A surrounding or nearby region
words.japaneseExplanation: 周辺の地域、または、近隣の地域。
words.example: You will find your bicycle somewhere in the neighborhood of the station.

words.englishDefinition: The middle of the day
words.japaneseExplanation: 真っ昼間。
words.example: We have lunch at noon every day.

words.englishDefinition: A personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
words.japaneseExplanation: 証拠または確証の基づかない個人的信条または判断。
words.example: You may be right, but I am against your opinion.

words.englishDefinition: Providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief ('comfy' is informal)
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的な幸福または安心を提供するか、経験するさま。
words.example: What can I do to make you feel more comfortable?

words.englishDefinition: Of or associated with the great masses of people
words.japaneseExplanation: 人々の大きな集団に関するまたはそれの。
words.example: I have a lot in common with him.

words.englishDefinition: Obviously contrived to charm
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかにうまく魅了する。
words.example: I wish there were some cute guys in my class.

words.englishDefinition: Devoid of or deficient in light or brightness; shadowed or black
words.japaneseExplanation: 光または明るさが欠けている、または、光または明るさが不十分な。陰になる、または黒い。
words.example: What happens in the dark always comes to light.

words.englishDefinition: Displaying numbers rather than scale positions
words.japaneseExplanation: 相対的な位置関係よりも数で表す。
words.example: My father bought me a digital watch for birthday present.

words.englishDefinition: Very good;of the highest quality
words.japaneseExplanation: 非常によい。最高品質の。
words.example: I consider him to be an excellent teacher.

words.japanese: 親しみやすい、友好的な
words.englishDefinition: Characteristic of or befitting a friend
words.japaneseExplanation: 友人の特徴または、に適するさま。
words.example: My uncle gave me a friendly piece of advice.

words.englishDefinition: Having or indicating good health in body or mind; free from infirmity or disease
words.japaneseExplanation: 体または心の健康を持つか、示すさま。虚弱または病気から解放されている。
words.example: We have to make sure that we stay healthy.

words.englishDefinition: Run away from confinement
words.japaneseExplanation: 監禁から逃げる。
words.example: You won't be able to escape from this prison.

words.englishDefinition: Make plain and comprehensible
words.japaneseExplanation: 平易で理解可能にする。
words.example: I found it impossible to explain what he is really like.

words.englishDefinition: Give expression to
words.japaneseExplanation: 表現をする。
words.example: I can't find the word to express what I feel.

words.englishDefinition: Be unsuccessful
words.japaneseExplanation: 失敗する。
words.example: Do you want our business to fail?

words.japanese: 食べ物を与える、餌をやる
words.englishDefinition: Give food to
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物を与える。
words.example: I don't think we have enough food to feed everyone.

words.englishDefinition: Decide upon or fix definitely
words.japaneseExplanation: 決めるか、確実に固定する。
words.example: We have to fix the date for our trip quickly.

words.englishDefinition: Bend or lay so that one part covers the other
words.japaneseExplanation: 一つの部分が他の部分を覆うように曲げるあるいは置く。
words.example: How many times have I told you to fold your clothes?

words.englishDefinition: Kitchen appliance used for baking or roasting
words.japaneseExplanation: ベーキングまたはローストのために使われる台所機器。
words.example: I took the cake out of the oven too early.

words.englishDefinition: comfortable clothes worn in bed
words.japaneseExplanation: 寝るときに着るパジャマ。通常は複数形で使う。
words.example: I put on my pajamas and went to bed.

words.englishDefinition: (astronomy) any of the nine large celestial bodies in the solar system that revolve around the sun and shine by reflected light; Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto in order of their proximity to the sun; viewed from the constellation Hercules, all the planets rotate around the sun in a counterclockwise direction
words.japaneseExplanation: 太陽の周りを公転し、反射光によって輝く太陽系の9つの大きな天体のいずれか。太陽から近い順に、水星、金星、地球、火星、木星、土星、天王星、海王星及び冥王星。
words.example: We were all born on this planet for a reason.

words.englishDefinition: A fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience
words.japaneseExplanation: 定義しにくいが人々が経験したいと思う根本的な感情。
words.example: What a pleasure it is to use the new system.

words.englishDefinition: A small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles
words.japaneseExplanation: 小物を運ぶための上着についている小袋。
words.example: I carry my set of keys in my pocket.

words.englishDefinition: The force of policemen and officers
words.japaneseExplanation: 警察官と警官の力。
words.example: We finally decided to give him over to the police.

words.englishDefinition: A young dog
words.japaneseExplanation: 小犬。
words.example: I have had this dog since she was a puppy.

words.englishDefinition: Medium for communication
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報伝達のメディア。
words.example: Do you listen to the radio at home every day?

words.englishDefinition: A temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to
words.japaneseExplanation: 出席しなければならないことを整理した仮の計画。
words.example: I can give you my schedule if you need it.

words.englishDefinition: A number that expresses the accomplishment of a team or an individual in a game or contest
words.japaneseExplanation: 試合やコンテストでのチームや個人の成績を表す数字。
words.example: What was the score of the game?

words.englishDefinition: a service that travels regularly between two places
words.japaneseExplanation: 二つの場所の間を繰り返し往復する交通機関。
words.example: There is a free shuttle from the hotel to the airport.

words.englishDefinition: The ability to see; the visual faculty
words.japaneseExplanation: 見る能力。視覚の機能。
words.example: My sight isn't as good as it used to be.

words.englishDefinition: An upholstered seat for more than one person
words.japaneseExplanation: 二人以上の人のための布張りをした席。
words.example: How many does the sofa seat?

words.englishDefinition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front
words.japaneseExplanation: （たいてい男子によって）カラーの下に付けられ前で結ばれる一枚の小幅の長い生地。
words.example: I wore this tie yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: A source of difficulty
words.japaneseExplanation: 困難のもと。
words.example: I am having trouble with one thing after another.

words.englishDefinition: Up to the immediate present; most recent or most up-to-date
words.japaneseExplanation: まさにこの現在まで。最近で最新の。
words.example: Do you want to stay up to date with all the latest news?

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係しているか適切であるか、より大きいというよりむしろ管理に都市、町または地区について関係がある領域。
words.example: I left my local area for the first time in a few days.

words.englishDefinition: Functioning or occurring in a normal way; lacking abnormalities or deficiencies
words.japaneseExplanation: 普通に機能すること、または、発生するさま。異常または欠陥がないこと。
words.example: I guess it's only natural.

words.englishDefinition: Absolutely essential
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要不可欠な。
words.example: Do you really believe that doing that is absolutely necessary?

words.englishDefinition: Characterized by an absence or near absence of agitation or activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 困惑または行動の欠如またはほぼ欠如することによって特徴づけられる。
words.example: I came out here to enjoy some peace and quiet.

words.englishDefinition: Having a circular shape
words.japaneseExplanation: 円形をしているさま。
words.example: We have snow on the mountain all the year round.

words.englishDefinition: Made afraid
words.japaneseExplanation: 恐れる。
words.example: I wanted to say something, but I was too scared.

words.englishDefinition: (used with count nouns) of an indefinite number more than 2 or 3 but not many
words.japaneseExplanation: 2または3よりも大きいが多くはない不定数の数。
words.example: I read the word several times, but couldn't remember it.

words.englishDefinition: Express greetings upon meeting someone
words.japaneseExplanation: 人に会うときに挨拶を表現する。
words.example: I want to be able to greet everyone in their native language.

words.englishDefinition: Prevent from being seen or discovered
words.japaneseExplanation: 見られる、または発見されるのを防ぐ。
words.example: We need to find a place to hide this money.

words.englishDefinition: Walk a long way, as for pleasure or physical exercise
words.japaneseExplanation: 楽しみや体操などのために長距離を歩く。
words.example: I want to hike up this mountain.

words.englishDefinition: Pursue for food or sport (as of wild animals)
words.japaneseExplanation: 食物またはスポーツのために追求する（野生動物のような）。
words.example: I can teach you how to hunt.

words.englishDefinition: Impress positively
words.japaneseExplanation: 明らかに印象づける。
words.example: You don't have to try so hard to impress me.

words.englishDefinition: Cause injuries or bodily harm to
words.japaneseExplanation: 怪我または身体傷害を引き起こす。
words.example: You have to be careful so as not to injure yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Discuss formally with (somebody) for the purpose of an evaluation
words.japaneseExplanation: （誰か）に対する評価の目的で正式に討議する。
words.example: We found someone else to interview for our school project.

words.englishDefinition: The sound made by the vibration of vocal folds modified by the resonance of the vocal tract
words.japaneseExplanation: 声道で調節される声帯の振動によって生じる音。
words.example: I just wanted to hear the sound of your voice.

words.englishDefinition: Something done (usually as opposed to something said)
words.japaneseExplanation: なされた事柄（通常、言われた事柄に対して言う）。
words.example: I invited Gustavo to watch an action movie with me.

words.englishDefinition: A proposal for an appropriate course of action
words.japaneseExplanation: 適切な方針の提案。
words.example: I need your advice on what I should do next.

words.englishDefinition: Give, especially as an honor or reward
words.japaneseExplanation: 特に名誉または報酬として、与える。
words.example: I would like to thank many people for helping me win this award, but I won't.

words.englishDefinition: The time at which something is supposed to begin
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かが始まるとされる時間。
words.example: I knew it would end like this from the beginning.

words.englishDefinition: the number one thousand million
words.japaneseExplanation: 現在の一般的な英語では十億を表す。
words.example: More than a billion people live in India.

words.englishDefinition: Sheet of slate; for writing with chalk
words.japaneseExplanation: 粘板岩の板。チョークで書くための。
words.example: I broke my glasses, so I couldn't see the blackboard.

words.englishDefinition: Temporary living quarters specially built by the army for soldiers
words.japaneseExplanation: 臨時の生活宿舎で特に軍隊によって兵士用に建てられたもの。
words.example: I went out on a camping trip.

words.englishDefinition: A seat of government
words.japaneseExplanation: 政府の所在地。
words.example: What is the capital of her country?

words.englishDefinition: A large building formerly occupied by a ruler and fortified against attack
words.japaneseExplanation: 以前の統治者により占有され、攻撃に対して要塞となっていた大きな建物。
words.example: What you are saying is nothing but building a castle in the air.

words.englishDefinition: The weather in some location averaged over some long period of time
words.japaneseExplanation: ある長い期間にわたってある場所で平均化された天気。
words.example: You can easily get sick in a climate like this.

words.englishDefinition: a book or magazine that tells stories through pictures
words.japaneseExplanation: 絵とせりふで物語を伝える漫画や漫画本。
words.example: I borrowed a comic from my friend yesterday.

words.englishDefinition: The activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝達する活動。情報を伝達する活動。
words.example: I think we get some communication problems here.

words.japanese: 損害を与える、傷つける
words.englishDefinition: Inflict damage upon
words.japaneseExplanation: 損害を与える。
words.example: I have the power to damage him.

words.englishDefinition: The condition of being susceptible to harm or injury
words.japaneseExplanation: 傷ついたり危害を受けやすい状況。
words.example: I couldn't leave you alone to face the danger by yourself.

words.englishDefinition: Having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
words.japaneseExplanation: ほとんど部品を持たないさま。複雑でない、面倒でない、あるいは入り組んでいない。
words.example: We came up with a very simple solution to the problem.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by the presence of snow
words.japaneseExplanation: 雪の存在によって特徴のある。
words.example: I remember that it was winter because it was really cold and snowy.

words.englishDefinition: From the south; used especially of wind
words.japaneseExplanation: 南から。特に風について使用される。
words.example: Our restaurant is near the southern bus station.

words.englishDefinition: Having strength or power greater than average or expected
words.japaneseExplanation: 強さまたは力を平均より大きいか期待されたようにしておくさま。
words.example: My father used to be a strong man.

words.englishDefinition: Having or denoting the characteristic taste of sugar
words.japaneseExplanation: 砂糖の特有の味を持つこと、または示すさま。
words.example: I saw a little girl who was sweet and happy.

words.englishDefinition: Not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
words.japaneseExplanation: 薄くない。特定の厚みの、または、1つの表面から正反対の通常3次元の固体の比較的大きな範囲の。
words.example: I cannot finish reading this thick book in a week.

words.englishDefinition: feeling that you need a drink
words.japaneseExplanation: 水分が欲しくて、のどが渇いていること。
words.example: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?

words.englishDefinition: Consisting of or derived from tradition
words.japaneseExplanation: 伝統から成る、または、伝統に由来する。
words.example: I live in a traditional Kabyle house.

words.englishDefinition: Judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
words.japaneseExplanation: とりあえず判断するまたは、の予想を立てる（量または時間）。
words.example: I think that it's too soon to judge.

words.englishDefinition: Produce laughter
words.japaneseExplanation: 笑いを引き起こす。
words.example: I didn't know whether to get angry or to laugh.

words.englishDefinition: Put into a certain place or abstract location
words.japaneseExplanation: ある一定の場所または抽象的な場所に置く。
words.example: I would lay down my life for you.

words.englishDefinition: Take somebody somewhere
words.japaneseExplanation: 誰かをどこかに連れて行く。
words.example: You can lead a horse to water, but you can't make him drink.

words.englishDefinition: Take in marriage
words.japaneseExplanation: 嫁にもらう。
words.example: I hope that your parents will allow us to marry.

words.englishDefinition: Add as an additional element or part
words.japaneseExplanation: 追加の要素または部分として付け加える。
words.example: I offered to mix the cake for him.

words.englishDefinition: Present for acceptance or rejection
words.japaneseExplanation: 承諾または拒絶を示す。
words.example: I was going to offer to buy you a drink.

words.englishDefinition: the end of a person's or animal's life
words.japaneseExplanation: 人や動物の命が終わることを表す名詞。
words.example: The story describes the family's feelings after their grandfather's death.

words.englishDefinition: Arid land with little or no vegetation
words.japaneseExplanation: 植物がほとんど、あるいはまったくない不毛の地域。
words.example: We got lost in the desert with no water or food.

words.englishDefinition: An effort that is inconvenient
words.japaneseExplanation: 面倒な努力。
words.example: I had a lot of difficulty getting in touch with her.

words.englishDefinition: Shaking and vibration at the surface of the earth resulting from underground movement along a fault plane of from volcanic activity
words.japaneseExplanation: 火山活動により断層面に沿った地下運動によって、地球の表面が揺れて震動すること。
words.example: I was playing a game when I felt an earthquake.

words.englishDefinition: Lifting device consisting of a platform or cage that is raised and lowered mechanically in a vertical shaft in order to move people from one floor to another in a building
words.japaneseExplanation: 垂直シャフト中を機械的に上昇降下する台またはケージで人を建物のある階から別の階へと運ぶためのもの。
words.example: I went up to the 5th floor in an elevator.

words.englishDefinition: An opposing military force
words.japaneseExplanation: 敵対する軍隊。
words.example: We have to drive the enemy out of our land.

words.englishDefinition: (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs
words.japaneseExplanation: 動作する物理的システムの容量と同等の熱力学量。エネルギーの単位はジュールとエルグである。
words.example: I don't think I have the energy to do that.

words.englishDefinition: A set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
words.japaneseExplanation: 技術あるいは知識を評価するための、一連の質問や問題。
words.example: We felt happy when the examination was over.

words.englishDefinition: Expression without words
words.japaneseExplanation: 言葉のない表現。
words.example: I actually heard someone use this expression just this morning.

words.englishDefinition: (usually plural) a device with an explosive that burns at a low rate and with colored flames; can be used to illuminate areas or send signals etc.
words.japaneseExplanation: 低速で、そして、色のついた炎で燃える火薬装置。領域を照らす、または、信号などを送るのに使用される。
words.example: We went to a firework festival.

words.englishDefinition: Emblem usually consisting of a rectangular piece of cloth of distinctive design
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常は特徴的なデザインをした長方形の布地で成るエンブレム。
words.example: Our flag is red and black.

words.englishDefinition: Cutlery used for serving and eating food
words.japaneseExplanation: 食べ物を出して食べるのに使用する食卓用刃物類。
words.example: We came to a fork in the road.

words.englishDefinition: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints
words.japaneseExplanation: 自由である状態。外部から抑制を課されない状態で行動する、話す、あるいは考える力。
words.example: I enjoy having the freedom to think for myself.

words.englishDefinition: A refrigerator in which the coolant is pumped around by an electric motor
words.japaneseExplanation: 冷却液が電気モーターによって周りに送り込まれる冷蔵庫。
words.example: I wonder how long this has been in the fridge.

words.englishDefinition: The state of being friends (or friendly)
words.japaneseExplanation: 友人（または友好的）であること。
words.example: Our friendship is the most beautiful thing in my life.

words.englishDefinition: Afflicted with or marked by anxious uneasiness or trouble or grief
words.japaneseExplanation: 気がかりな不安、トラブルまたは悲しみに苦しめられるまたは、それらに特徴付けられる。
words.example: I used to get upset about everything, too.

words.englishDefinition: Including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
words.japaneseExplanation: 例外なくすべての構成要素を含むさま。1つ全体または全ての量、程度または持続時間をなす。
words.example: I spent the whole weekend at home on the computer.

words.englishDefinition: Possessing life
words.japaneseExplanation: 生命を有する。
words.example: I have done everything I could to keep him alive.

words.englishDefinition: Being full of or promoting cheer; having or showing good spirits
words.japaneseExplanation: 声援でいっぱいのまたは声援をすすめる。良い気分を持つまたは示す。
words.example: I had a cheerful morning because I could hear the songs of birds.

words.englishDefinition: Soiled or likely to soil with dirt or grime
words.japaneseExplanation: 汚れまたはほこり汚れたまたは汚れるような。
words.example: My shirt is clean, and yours is dirty.

words.englishDefinition: Advanced in years; ('aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
words.japaneseExplanation: 年を取っている。
words.example: My parents told me that we should respect the elderly.

words.englishDefinition: Providing assistance or serving a useful function
words.japaneseExplanation: 援助を提供する、または、役に立つ機能を供給する。
words.example: You can be pretty helpful when you want to be.

words.englishDefinition: Unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
words.japaneseExplanation: 通常、サイズ、量、度数、特に程度または範囲において大きな。
words.example: We could be making a huge mistake here.

words.englishDefinition: Cultivate by growing, often involving improvements by means of agricultural techniques
words.japaneseExplanation: 育成して栽培する、しばしは農業技術の方法の改良を含む。
words.example: We don't produce anything any more.

words.englishDefinition: Cause to move by pulling
words.japaneseExplanation: 引くことにより動きを引き起こす。
words.example: I think she was trying to pull a fast one.

words.englishDefinition: Be fully aware or cognizant of
words.japaneseExplanation: 十分に認知しているまたは認識している。
words.example: I think it's important to realize that may not happen.

words.englishDefinition: to store information or sound so it can be used later
words.japaneseExplanation: 情報や音などを後で使えるように残すこと。
words.example: Can I record the lesson to review it later?

words.japanese: 再利用する、再資源化する
words.englishDefinition: Use again after processing
words.japaneseExplanation: 処理の後で再度使用する。
words.example: I wish more people would recycle.

words.englishDefinition: Emit light; be bright, as of the sun or a light
words.japaneseExplanation: 発光する。太陽または光で明るくする。
words.example: You just need to clean it, and it will shine.

words.englishDefinition: The feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
words.japaneseExplanation: 何か悪いものが偶然起こるときあなたが抱く苦悩と不信感。
words.example: I expect him to get over the shock of his failure.

words.englishDefinition: All the people living at the same time or of approximately the same age
words.japaneseExplanation: 同じ時代に生きている人々やほぼ同年代の人々。
words.example: People of my generation all think the same way about this.

words.englishDefinition: Motion of hands or body to emphasize or help to express a thought or feeling
words.japaneseExplanation: 考えや感情を強調したり、表現の助けとなる、手や体の動き。
words.example: I just wanted to make a gesture.

words.englishDefinition: A brittle transparent solid with irregular atomic structure
words.japaneseExplanation: 不規則な原子構造をもった砕けやすい透明な固体。
words.example: Could you get me a glass of ice water, please?

words.englishDefinition: Handwear: covers the hand and wrist
words.japaneseExplanation: 手に付けるもの：手と手首を覆う。
words.example: My hands were getting cold, so I put on my gloves.

words.englishDefinition: A metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram
words.japaneseExplanation: 1キログラムの1000分の1と同等の重さの計量単位。
words.example: I would like 500 grams of meat please.

words.englishDefinition: A parent of your father or mother
words.japaneseExplanation: 父あるいは母の親。
words.example: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.

words.englishDefinition: (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)
words.japaneseExplanation: 善意（特に会議での）の承認または表現力。
words.example: I didn't return the greeting.

words.englishDefinition: A form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature
words.japaneseExplanation: 温度差によって移動するエネルギーの形態。
words.example: We got caught up in the heat of the moment.

words.englishDefinition: An indirect suggestion
words.japaneseExplanation: 間接暗示。
words.example: You could at least give me a hint.

words.englishDefinition: An opening into or through something
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かの中へ、あるいは通り抜ける始まり。
words.example: I need this like I need a hole in the head.

words.englishDefinition: Solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times
words.japaneseExplanation: 先史時代から家畜化されている、蹄のある草食性の四肢動物。
words.example: I have brought here only my clothes and my horse.

words.englishDefinition: A person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there
words.japaneseExplanation: （自宅でのパーティーといった）社交行事でお客を招き、滞在中の世話をする人。
words.example: I want to thank my host family.

words.englishDefinition: The quality of being important and worthy of note
words.japaneseExplanation: 重要で、注目に値するという特質。
words.example: Do you understand the importance of what you are saying?

words.englishDefinition: The liquid part that can be extracted from plant or animal tissue by squeezing or cooking
words.japaneseExplanation: しぼれるか、料理することによって設備または動物性組織から引き抜かれることができる液体の一部。
words.example: You can drink the juice that's on the table.

words.englishDefinition: A liquid used for printing or writing or drawing
words.japaneseExplanation: 印刷や筆記、描画に使われる液体。
words.example: You have some ink on your face.

words.englishDefinition: Not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
words.japaneseExplanation: 生じることができない、達成されない、または対処されることができない。
words.example: We find ourselves in an impossible situation.

words.englishDefinition: Concerning or belonging to all or at least two or more nations
words.japaneseExplanation: すべての国、あるいは少なくとも2カ国以上の国に関係があるか、または属しているさま。
words.example: I would like to learn English for international travel.

words.englishDefinition: Marked by dejection from being alone
words.japaneseExplanation: 一人であることからの落胆により特徴づけられる。
words.example: I felt sad and lonely.

words.englishDefinition: Less than normal in degree or intensity or amount
words.japaneseExplanation: 程度、強さまたは量で通常以下である。
words.example: Our prices are so low, we must be crazy!

words.englishDefinition: Having or bringing good fortune
words.japaneseExplanation: 幸運を持っている、あるいはもたらすさま。
words.example: I was lucky enough to get a good seat.

words.englishDefinition: Mild and pleasant
words.japaneseExplanation: 穏やかで、楽しい。
words.example: We had a mild winter last year.

words.englishDefinition: Full of or characterized by loud and nonmusical sounds
words.japaneseExplanation: 大きくて音楽的でないな音で満ちている、または、大きくて音楽的でないな音に特徴づけられる。
words.example: I can't study anywhere in my house. It's too noisy.

words.englishDefinition: (of a church) given official status as a national or state institution
words.japaneseExplanation: （教会について）国家または州の機関として公式の地位を与えられた。
words.example: What is the official language of your country?

words.englishDefinition: Orally recite the letters of or give the spelling of
words.japaneseExplanation: 口頭で文字を暗唱する、またはスペリングを伝える。
words.example: Could you please tell me how to spell your name?

words.englishDefinition: (law) someone who owns (is legal possessor of) a business
words.japaneseExplanation: （法的占有者である）企業を所有する人。
words.example: I went inside the house and talked to the owner.

words.englishDefinition: High in price or charging high prices
words.japaneseExplanation: 値段が高い、または高い値段で請求する。
words.example: I can't afford to shop at such an expensive store.

words.englishDefinition: Relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
words.japaneseExplanation: 関係しているか適切であるか、より大きいというよりむしろ管理に都市、町または地区について関係がある領域。
words.example: I left my local area for the first time in a few days.

words.englishDefinition: Give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
words.japaneseExplanation: ある印象を与える、またはある外観を持つ。
words.example: You don't seem to like to do that very much.

words.englishDefinition: The organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
words.japaneseExplanation: 政治体の行政部門である組織。
words.example: What do you do for the government?

words.englishDefinition: A medical procedure involving an incision with instruments; performed to repair damage or arrest disease in a living body
words.japaneseExplanation: 器具を使用しての切開を伴う医療行為。生体の損傷を修復する、または疾病を食い止めるために行われる。
words.example: How long will the operation take?

words.englishDefinition: Not commonly encountered
words.japaneseExplanation: 一般的に出会わない。
words.example: I saw something very unusual on my way here.

words.englishDefinition: Restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
words.japaneseExplanation: 部分を取り替えるまたは裂けているか、壊れているものを組み立てることにより修復する。
words.example: What would it cost to repair this chair?

words.englishDefinition: A period of 100 years
words.japaneseExplanation: 100年の期間。
words.example: How many years are there in a century?

words.englishDefinition: A traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
words.japaneseExplanation: 乗り物（船、バス、車、飛行機、列車等）で旅をし、その運転・操縦をしていない人。
words.example: I feel nervous when I am a passenger on a bus.

words.englishDefinition: Providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief ('comfy' is informal)
words.japaneseExplanation: 身体的な幸福または安心を提供するか、経験するさま。
words.example: What can I do to make you feel more comfortable?

words.englishDefinition: Exercising caution or showing care or attention
words.japaneseExplanation: 警戒する、留意または注意を示すさま。
words.example: You must be very careful when you do that.

words.englishDefinition: Make ready or suitable or equip in advance for a particular purpose or for some use, event, etc
words.japaneseExplanation: 特定の目的、使用、あるいは出来事のためにあらかじめ準備しておく、整える、備える。
words.example: I have to prepare to go to school.

words.englishDefinition: Become bigger or greater in amount
words.japaneseExplanation: 量がより大きくなる。
words.example: I would like to increase the price.

words.englishDefinition: A way of doing something, especially a systematic way; implies an orderly logical arrangement (usually in steps)
words.japaneseExplanation: 何かを行う方法、特に体系的なもの。秩序だって理論的な（通常、段階を進んでいく）方法を意味する。
words.example: I can say from experience that this method works.

words.englishDefinition: Absolutely essential
words.japaneseExplanation: 必要不可欠な。
words.example: Do you really believe that doing that is absolutely necessary?

words.englishDefinition: Marked by correspondence or resemblance
words.japaneseExplanation: 一致または類似を特徴とする。
words.example: I had a similar problem when I lived in Boston.

words.englishDefinition: Be in accord; be in agreement
words.japaneseExplanation: 一致している。合意する。
words.example: I could agree with you, but then we'd both be wrong.

words.englishDefinition: An anticipated outcome that is intended or that guides your planned actions
words.japaneseExplanation: 意図している、または計画した行動を導く、予期された結果。
words.example: You need to find a purpose to your life.

words.englishDefinition: Of the immediate past or just previous to the present time
words.japaneseExplanation: すぐ最近の過去の、あるいは、現在よりちょうど少し前の時間。
words.example: We got to know each other rather well on our recent trip.

words.englishDefinition: Not agitated; without losing self-possession
words.japaneseExplanation: 扇動されない。冷静さを失うことなく。
words.example: I tried to keep my voice calm.

words.englishDefinition: Act in accordance with someone's rules, commands, or wishes
words.japaneseExplanation: 人の支配、命令または要望の見合って行動する。
words.example: You must follow the rules of the game.

words.englishDefinition: to have or produce a particular smell
words.japaneseExplanation: 物から特定のにおいがすること。smell good で「よいにおいがする」。
words.example: The bread in the oven smells wonderful.

words.englishDefinition: A state at a particular time
words.japaneseExplanation: 一定の時の状況。
words.example: I will run under the condition that it's not raining.

words.englishDefinition: In place of, or as an alternative to
words.japaneseExplanation: 代理でまたは代替手段で。
words.example: You know, maybe we should buy a computer instead.

words.englishDefinition: A worker who is hired to perform a job
words.japaneseExplanation: 仕事をするために雇われた労働者。
words.example: I am an employee at a company.

words.englishDefinition: An extended fictional work in prose; usually in the form of a story
words.japaneseExplanation: 散文で書かれた長い虚構の作品。普通物語の形である。
words.example: I was in Algeria, working on a novel.

words.englishDefinition: In addition
words.japaneseExplanation: 加えて。
words.example: I woke up next to an unknown girl again. Moreover, she isn't ugly at all this time.

words.englishDefinition: Stay clear from; keep away from; keep out of the way of someone or something
words.japaneseExplanation: 接触がないままでいる。離れた状態を維持する。
words.example: We took a back road to avoid the heavy traffic.

words.englishDefinition: in a lower position than something
words.japaneseExplanation: 基準となる物より低い位置や数値を表す。
words.example: Please write your name below the title.

words.englishDefinition: In a regular manner
words.japaneseExplanation: 規則的な方法で。
words.example: I regularly start to fall asleep while watching a movie.

words.englishDefinition: despite the fact that
